The sixth day of the first month of 2013, more than eight o'clock in the morning, the sky is cloudy in Suzhou, Zheng Yuming driving his new 2012 Grand Cherokee SUV from a villa out of a large supermarket, Zheng Yuming let the SUV turned into the supermarket underground parking lot, his destination today is not here, but more than a hundred kilometers away from the Suzhou countryside, where there are Zheng family contracted for more than a decade of the flower and tree bases, bases away from the The nearest city to an hour's drive, Zheng Yuming most of the time each year to stay there, he did not want to add supplies specifically to drive an hour to go shopping, ready to buy more daily necessities in the supermarket in Suzhou to take to the spare.
Zheng Yuming twenty-eight years old this year, graduated from university five years ago, in the university of mechanical design and manufacturing, but Zheng Yuming graduated from the job looking for a resume did not have time to go to the interview, because of the changes in the family, did not become a white-collar workers in the metropolis, but to go to the countryside more than a hundred kilometers away from home to become a flower planting large households.
Zheng Yuming abandoned white-collar into flower farmers, all because Zheng's father in the son after graduation, heart attack, to the hospital to do a heart bypass surgery, after the operation of Zheng's father's weak body can not be competent to go to the management of more than a hundred kilometers away from the base of the flowers and trees, the Zheng family's flowers and trees contracted to face the situation of no one to run the business.
Zheng's father has been operating that flower and tree base for ten years, the earnings are good, the Zheng family therefore among the ten million middle class, this ten million family property is not calculated by bank deposits, but by the value of the flowers and trees planted on the base, the Zheng family at that time, if the transfer of the flower and tree base, the base of the flowers and trees will have to be sold at a low price, in that case, the Zheng family will have to lose a few million dollars.
Zheng Yuming think, they do white-collar in the city, do not know how many years to earn a few million, since working for others do not know how long to earn so much money, it is better to go directly to his father's class, the family's flower and tree base to continue to operate. Zheng Yuming so after the intention, but also did not discuss with their girlfriends in school, it is directly baggage to leave the metropolis, went to a hundred kilometers away from the countryside.
Zheng Yuming is still in the university did not graduate girlfriend learned of this, one is angry at the boyfriend's silent decision, the second is not like the rural life, feel Zheng Yuming to the base of the flowers and trees, all day and night and mud and grass and trees to deal with, it is not really how decent work, in the base of the flowers and trees to visit and see the boyfriend dressed in muddy coveralls, like sanitation workers in the pruning of flowers, branches, did not stop to return to the School, returned to Zheng Yuming called to break up.
At that time, Zheng Yuming just arrived at the base of their own flowers and trees, one to learn the craft of flowers and trees, the second to manage the base of miscellaneous, every day to arrange for the base of workers to repair the flowers and trees, to cope with the sales of flowers and trees business, busy no time to feel sad about the loss of love, such as Zheng Yuming on the base of the flowers and trees are familiar with the hands of the Ivory Tower romance is not to be placed on the heart.
Zheng Yuming's hometown is near the flower base, Zheng Yuming was brought up by his rural grandparents when he was a child, the countryside cordial and have a good sense of the countryside, because often followed by his grandfather on the ground, Zheng Yuming has a strange sense of good sense of the land, he felt that the black ghost of the land is magical, magical, a color that can grow all kinds of purple, a wide variety of plants, is the most wonderful existence of nature. Because of a heartfelt love for the land, Zheng Yuming stayed very happy in the flower base.
Zheng Yuming five years in business, now not only has mastered the planting and maintenance of flowers and trees technology, but also to expand the sales of their own flowers and trees, flowers and trees assets from five years ago to ten million, operating to nearly 100 million today, two years ago in Suzhou for his parents to buy a set of ten million villas, last year, he spent seven or eight hundred thousand for a Grand Cherokee SUV.
Economic affluence, but the lifelong problem has not been solved, at first you can say that the age of the young, first create a career, marriage issues and so on, last year Zheng Yuming twenty-seven years old, Zheng mother saw relatives and friends of the children are in this age before the marriage of the children, not calm, such as the son of the return to the Su City over the Spring Festival, will arrange for his son to go around the blind date.
To be honest, Zheng Yuming if not put on overalls to the flower wood to direct the workers work, put on the set of lines to meet with the flower wood customers, the whole person looks to be rich and handsome, such a good condition, scrambling to Zheng Yuming introduced the object of friends and relatives scrambling to be the first to Zheng Yuming in Suzhou over the seven days of spring break, rushed to the ten blind date, blind date to see the object of Zheng Yuming dazzling, the first five nights, Zheng Yuming and then even rushed to two! The evening of the fifth, Zheng Yuming rushed to two blind date banquet, the blind date sent home, dragging the tired body back to his parents' villa Zheng Yuming vowed to leave Suzhou early tomorrow, to return to their own paradise.
In the afternoon of the seventh day of a flower and tree businessman to go to the Zheng family flower and tree base to talk about business, Zheng Yuming used this as an excuse to persuade his parents to let him return to the flower and tree base in the morning of the sixth day of the first day of the first day of the second day of the second day.
Zheng mother although reluctant to leave her son, but the family's flower base is the root of the Zheng family, the heart has a thousand reluctance, but also had to go to the base for her son to open the supplies, the trunk was stuffed with Zheng mother, which is mainly a variety of New Year's Eve goods, the back seat was also put full of clothing by the Zheng mother, the clothes are Zheng mother in the year before to help her son buy.
Zheng mother stuffed into her son's car although a lot of things, but Zheng Yuming is still missing a lot of necessities, the end of the year back to Suzhou, the flower and wood base of the toothbrush, toothpaste and shampoo is going to run out of the base of the townships near the base does not have Zheng Yuming used to use the kind of brand of household goods, the Grand Cherokee SUV drove to a large supermarket when Zheng Yuming turned into it.
Supermarket underground parking lot a lot of cars, Zheng Yuming aimed at the corner of an empty parking space, hastily hit the steering wheel turned over and parked, the car turned off after pulling the handbrake, Zheng Yuming opened the door, his nose sniffed the air there is a faint smell of blood, he looked around and found nothing unusual around the ground, Zheng Yuming thought, probably whoever's car windows are not closed, buy the smell of raw meat drifted out.
Zheng Yuming only carrying the car keys, empty hands from the car down, out of the car, he walked towards the parking lot elevator, his Grand Cherokee after the car, the car in a certain period of time will automatically lock, Zheng Yuming has been accustomed to not using the car keys remote locking the car, just waiting for the Grand Cherokee automatically lock, Zheng Yuming walked to the elevator before the press on the upward arrow, behind the sound of Grand Cherokee locks also came.
The sixth day of the first month of the supermarket crowd, some are buying gifts to pay tribute to the New Year, some are ready to buy ingredients to entertain guests, Zheng Yuming pushed the shopping cart around to find the items they need, a lot of things with a long shelf-life and no shelf-life of the items, was Zheng Yuming threw the car by the handful of turn to sell agricultural products, Zheng Yuming feel that he did not need the things here, they pushed the shopping cart is ready to leave, ready to leave, an old lady standing in front of the corn pile accidentally swung the pile of corn to the ground, the corn fell right in front of Zheng Yuming shopping cart. An old lady standing in front of a pile of corn, accidentally swung the pile of corn to the ground, corn fell right in front of Zheng Yuming shopping cart, Zheng Yuming stopped the car, squatted down and the old lady together to pick up the corn to the container.
"This kind of corn is also put up for sale, it can be used as seed!" The old woman muttered as she picked up the corn.
Zheng Yuming looked at the corn he had picked up in his hands, and sure enough, the corn on the cob was yellow and orange, the very old kind, not the tender kind.
"Oops, this lady, this corn is dealt with at a reduced price, the old is a bit older, but the price is much cheaper." Next to the supermarket shopper to see here out of the situation, and hastily also ran over to pick up the yellow corn scattered on the ground.
"It's no cheaper than tender corn, is it? This old corn is not very tasty when cooked." Zheng Yuming pointed at the price board and commented.
"Hehehe, isn't it good enough to make seeds if it's not good? Anyway, there's a use for it, isn't there? Buy one now, next year become a basket of it." The shopper looked at the hands of the old corn is also happy, and even joked with Zheng Yuming.
Zheng Yuming shopping cart a lot of things, but he remembers that he absolutely did not throw the old corn into the shopping cart, when the cashier took a bag of weighed corn brush magnet, Zheng Yuming froze, is he really want to take a bag of corn back to the flower base to plant out a few baskets?
"That corn isn't mine." Jung Yuming stated to the cashier.
"That's nine hundred and seventy-eight." The cashier's face was expressionless.
"I don't want that corn." Jung Yuming affirmed again.
"Nine hundred and seventy-eight." Still expressionless.
Cashier expressionless, standing behind Zheng Yuming customers are dissatisfied, they are waiting for the checkout, have exported to urge Zheng Yuming quickly pay to leave.
"...." Zheng Yuming with a helpless face pulled out his bank card and gave it to the cashier, apparently the cashier was afraid of trouble and refused to return the bag of corn, anyway, a bag of corn is not worth a few dollars, buy it, maybe Woody would like to eat old corn. Wood is Zheng Yuming's watchdog that he keeps at the Flower and Wood Base.
Zheng Yuming pulled out a bank card, the cashier no longer wooden expressionless, she quickly swiped the card, but also to Zheng Yuming squeezed a smile, that smile Zheng Yuming back seeped up goosebumps, this cashier fast into a cyborg, see the customer first said hello, and then brush the magnetic brush, brush the cashier, after collecting squeeze a smile and throw it away, to face the next customer to repeat the procedure again.
Zheng Yuming swiped the card checkout depressed, cart ride elevator and depressed, his shoulder was rushed out of the elevator a strong man bumped, the heel of the strong man after the accomplices stepped on, Zheng Yuming did not have time to reason with these two, the two men full of fury walked away.
"What man? Rushing to reincarnation?" Zheng Yuming quenched a bite towards the two men who walked away, limping into the elevator, he felt, today he went out without looking at the yellow calendar, did not look at today's ox is not appropriate to go out, Zheng Yuming was born in 85 years, the Chinese zodiac is precisely the ox.
The parking lot was still full of cars, but what made Zheng Yuming strange was that there were several big men walking around the parking lot as if they were looking for something, and when those men saw Zheng Yuming pushing a shopping cart over, they stared for a few moments and then stopped paying attention.
Zheng Yuming intuition that this parking lot is odd, thinking about quickly leaving this place of wrongdoing, he opened the driver's door, part of the shopping bags thrown to the passenger seat, the rest directly from the driver's seat thrown to the back seat. Shopping cart things to carry clear, Zheng Yuming will start the SUV on fire, quickly drive away from the supermarket underground parking lot, towards the suburbs of the highway exit.
After Zheng Yuming's car left the underground parking lot of the supermarket, after about ten minutes, the big man who had been looking for something in the parking lot, walked to the place where Zheng Yuming's SUV was parked, and found that there were two inconspicuous bloodstains on that parking space.

Zheng Yuming's off-road vehicle to let go of the speed to run, in the highway can easily pull up to two hundred yards, but in the streets of downtown Suzhou, any you are the speed of the plane, you can only go with the turtle to race.
After countless traffic lights, the SUV finally drove on the highway, on the highway, Zheng Yuming's SUV can finally be like a wild horse off the reins of the wild, drove half an hour, Zheng Yuming saw a gas station ahead, aiming at their own tank marking has been more than half, they turned into the gas station, ready to fill the tank.
When the car was filled with gas, Zheng Yuming rolled down the window and handed the gasoline girl RMB.
"What's that smell?" The little gasoline girl sniffed her nose a few times, took the four hundred dollar bills, and numbly made change for the customer.
"Not the gasoline smell?" Zheng Yuming opened the window, straight felt the gasoline smell heavier, this gasoline girl can still smell other than gasoline smell?
"It's not the gasoline smell, it's weird." The gas girl finished making change and turned toward the car waiting for gas behind her.
Zheng Yuming restarted the car and rolled up the window, now it is winter, opened the next window, the temperature in the car are down a lot, once the window is closed, the temperature in the buggy quickly back up.
Zheng Yuming drove the car forward a few steps and then stopped, he felt that there was really a strange smell in his carriage, what was it? Is his mom put the New Year's Eve goods on the back seat of the car?
Jung Yoo Ming wanted to see what exactly had been stuffed in the backseat by his own mother, emitting an odor as the temperature inside the car rose, and when he turned back to look at the backseat, he was suddenly startled by a man's head emerging from behind his own driver's seat.
"Don't move!" The man's voice was low, his eyes were sharp, his appearance looked like he was in his early thirties, and Zheng Yuming's heart alarmed long in his heart just by looking at this kind of eyes, which was not something ordinary people had.
"Who are you?" Zheng Yuming asked this sentence as a reflex.
"Turn around! Keep driving for me, don't worry, I'm just hitchhiking." It would be fine if it was really a hitchhiker, but this man was holding a pistol in his hand, and the blackened muzzle of the gun was pointing at the owner of the car.
"Where are you going?" Turned back to the body of Zheng Yuming shivered a little, he grew to twenty-eight years old has not fought with people it, this did not do violent things good people, all of a sudden on the murderous murder weapon, said not afraid can not be normal.
"Go to your flower and wood base." The hitchhiker guest watched Zheng Yuming start the car while trembling, and couldn't help but let out a light laugh, "Don't worry, I'll just borrow your place to take shelter, I won't harm your life."
"This big brother, Flowerwood Base is too far, it takes two hours to drive there, I'll send you down to the next intersection, okay." As soon as Zheng Yuming heard that this hijacker wanted to go to Flowerwood Base to hide, he was very anxious in his heart and regretted brushing any advertisements on the SUV, allowing the kidnappers to get to the bottom of his situation in one fell swoop.
"Does it mean you can call the police if you drop me off?" The hitchhiker kidnapper put a pistol to the meat ticket's waist.
"No! Where will the police be called! Never call the police! If you don't believe me, you can search my cell phone." Zheng Yuming wanted to do this in his heart.
"Drive to the Flower and Wood Base, I'm going to trouble you to entertain me today."
The downwind car kidnapper closed his eyes, his right calf was hit by the enemy's silenced pistol, fortunately the bullet came out through the muscle and didn't stay in the calf, after climbing into Zheng Yuming's SUV in the underground parking lot of the supermarket, he used the towel in the car to bandage his calf, and the wound was tightened, and the bleeding was no longer strong. This treatment is also just to get rid of their own blood loss and death, the loss of a large amount of blood is still affecting the body, downwind guests feel that their energy is declining, he must find a place to recuperate, the owner of this SUV he hijacked, at a glance, is not particularly bold, nor is it particularly timid, it is suitable for him to be a hostage.
Hitchhiker kidnappers think so because, especially bold people will think of resistance, especially timid people will be scared of the six gods, can not give him as a driver to take him to escape, so the hitchhiker kidnappers identified Zheng Yuming's character, immediately change the idea of getting off halfway, decided to kidnap Zheng Yuming until he recovered his physical strength.
The miserable meat ticket didn't know that his performance of being neither bold nor timid was favored by the kidnapper before he made up his mind to follow him closely to the Hanamaki base, and in his mind, he was still figuring out how to get rid of the man on the way.
"Drive faster!" Watching a home car overtake the SUV from behind, the kidnapper became disgruntled and pushed his pistol against Zheng Yuming's waist again.
Zheng Yuming grinding work can not do, simply dead pedal throttle, pull the speed to two hundred yards, counting on such speeding on the highway can attract the attention of the traffic police, so that may be able to use the help of the police, escape from the hands of the kidnappers.
Unfortunately, there were no patrols on the highway, and Zheng Yuming's speeding didn't serve any purpose except to provoke national curses from the overtaken driver, which in turn shortened the time to the Flower and Wood Base.
Should we get a car accident to get out of it? Crash into a big truck? I'm afraid that if I hit the truck, not only will the kidnappers be knocked out and killed, but I might have to go with them too. Hit the railing? I'm sure the car will be destroyed if I hit it at this speed.
In Zheng Yuming left and right, turning to the Zheng family flower and tree base of the road sign appeared, looking at the road sign on the country's largest flower and tree market to welcome you to the slogan, Zheng Yuming dead, the kidnappers seem to be going to set his paradise today.
Off-road vehicle turned on the fork in the road, Zheng family flowers and trees near the base is one of the country's largest flower and tree trading market, in the trading market around more than ten kilometers of land, planted everywhere are flowers and trees, the field basically do not see the food.
"The scenery here is good." The kidnapper sat on the clothing in the backseat, his head leaning against the back of Zheng Yuming's driver's seat, his right hand holding the gun had been on top of Zheng Yuming, probably feeling that the purpose was almost here, he actually had the leisure to survey the outside of the car window, and saw that the fields, even in the winter, were lush everywhere, and could not help but open his mouth to marvel at it.
"Eh, this is the most famous hometown of flowers and trees in the country." Zheng Yuming couldn't get rid of the kidnappers, so he had to think of ways to ensure his own safety, and getting close to the kidnappers could make the kidnappers feel good about him, and maybe the kidnappers would let him be safe for this if they reached their wish.
"Your family's flower base is quite famous, isn't it? I see that the advertisement slogan on the car has quite a big mouth." The advertising slogan on Zheng Yuming's SUV was, Wholesale Flowers and Trees with the Best Reputation in the Hometown of Flowers and Trees.
"General, general!" Zheng Yuming modest, he at least counts as a billionaire, but don't be this kidnapper knows that he has a little bit of assets, go to hide into a kidnapping for ransom, that can be unlucky plus unfortunate.
Speaking, the SUV out of the highway ramp, driving on a four-lane asphalt road, and then drive forward for twenty minutes to arrive at the Zheng family tree base.
"Then the villa in the flower and wood field in front is your house?" The kidnappers saw a signboard on the side of the road that reads 'Zheng Family's Flower and Wood Field', with an arrow pointing directly to a gray-brick, red-tiled, three-room, two-and-a-half-storey villa in the middle of the flower and wood field, which is surrounded by a concrete courtyard wall, which has a courtyard gate opposite the road, and which is connected to the asphalt road by a concrete road.
"Yes." Jung Yuming had a hard time understanding why the instruction sign had to be made so eye-catching that people couldn't even try to turn a blind eye to it.
Zheng Yuming back to Suzhou for the Spring Festival, the flower base entrusted to the Zheng family a distant relative care, the relative than Zheng Yuming father is three years older, but the generation and Zheng Yuming the same generation, Zheng Yuming see the hair white relatives, as long as the call sound old brother, the distant brother is the flower base of the fixed workers.
Zheng Yuming's SUV turned onto the concrete road, Zheng Yuming's distant old brother flashed out from the courtyard door, a look at the cousin boss's car drove over, and hastily pulled the courtyard door open, the courtyard door is made of stainless steel material, very solid, Zheng Yuming's car has always been driven directly into the courtyard.
"Little Ming, what a coincidence, I was just about to go home when you came." Zheng Yuming's old cousin said to his cousin who had rolled down the car window.
"Thank you, old man! You go back." Zheng Yuming turned off the car but didn't get out; his waist was still being held up by the hitchhiking kidnapper, who demanded that Zheng Yuming send his old cousin away.
"Let's have lunch at your oldest brother's house, eh, you've even brought a guest, so let's go together." Now's is already lunch time, Zheng Yuming's cousin invites Zheng Yuming and the kidnapper to have lunch at his own home in the village in front of him, it's the first month of the year, and there are abundant meals at home.
"No, we'll eat in the villa." Zheng Yuming's waist was pushed by the kidnapper again, and he hastily voiced his refusal.
"That's good, I'll go home first, I've already fed Woody." Zheng Yuming's cousin stayed at the villa at night to look after it, and went back to his own home in the morning, and at lunchtime brought in the meal to feed the watchdog Zheng Yuming had raised, this brownish-yellow wolfdog called Woody started barking ever since Zheng Yuming's car had turned into the concrete road, it was very familiar with the sound of its master's car, and seeing that its master had entered the yard but didn't bother to look at it, Woody was upset, jumping from left to right, earning a clanging of the iron chain that was bolted to it.
After Jung Yuming's distant cousin left,, the kidnapper himself got out of the back seat first and commanded Jung Yuming to get out of the driver's seat with the pistol in his hand.
Zheng Yuming a car, only to find that the kidnapper who kidnapped him is very tall, there are 183 centimeters, the kidnapper's upper body is a black down jacket, the lower body is a dark blue jeans, the right calf with a towel wrapped in the car, the white towel has seeped red.
The chained wood roared furiously, beasts were sometimes more sensitive than humans, it smelled blood, and even though the wood was accustomed to strangers coming and going, animal instincts led it to believe that the tall human with the blood on his legs was a threat to his master.
"Woody! Not allowed to bark!" Zheng Yuming is afraid that the kidnappers are impatient wolf dog barking, directly to the wood a shot, after getting out of the car, Zheng Yuming more dare not move, one is the kidnappers high body strong, the second is that the kidnappers pistol is actually equipped with a silencer, angry kidnappers to give themselves and the wood a shot, the people in the distance simply can not hear the sound.
Woody was chastised by his master and no longer roared wildly at the stranger, but he was still wary, a low, threatening sound coming from his throat.
"This dog is good." The kidnapper was walking with a bit of a limp because his right leg was injured, he followed Zheng Yuming into the villa. "Is there any wound medicine, bandage me up, bandage me up and rest and I'll leave, don't worry, you and I have no grudges, I won't take your life, it's just that I'll have to tie you up when I leave."
"I have a first aid kit here." Zheng Yuming's attitude immediately warmed up once he heard that he could get away as long as he helped the kidnapper's wounds.
Zheng Yuming villa medicine a lot of drugs, and most of the wound medicine, because the base workers will always work accidentally out of the wound, these small wounds are too lazy to go to the hospital bandage, are their own cleaning down the wound, sprinkle a little powder bandage thing.
Zheng Yuming obediently take out the first aid kit, (not good can not, the kidnapper's gun is always on him.) With scissors to the kidnapper's wound at the pants cut open, cleaned with alcohol, looking at the deep eye of the gun, Zheng Yuming winced, this wound look at the pain, but the kidnappers in Zheng Yuming with alcohol disinfection, frowning did not wrinkle a little bit, see the kidnappers character of perseverance and simmering strength, such a character of perseverance in the requirements to be met, will not keep the promise to spare themselves? Zheng Yuming heart and began to wander, the man was injured is robbed wounded ah, whether by the police or enemy shot, all indicate one thing, the gun off the kidnapper experience complex.
Just when Zheng Yuming was ready to take the powder to the kidnapper's wound, the yard was chained to the wolf dog wood issued a mournful bark, this barking let the villa in the two men were startled for a moment, not waiting for the two men to get up to go to the yard to inspect what happened, the two men in front of their eyes suddenly flashed a strong light, the last memory of the two men's minds is that the light can be really blue ah!
Zheng Yuming's old cousin just walked to the entrance of the village, only to hear a loud bang behind him, the ground underfoot trembling, Zheng Yuming's old cousin's first reaction is an earthquake, but the ground only trembled for a moment and no movement, this phenomenon is not very much like an earthquake, but what is the loud bang behind him?
Zheng Yuming's old cousin turned back to look at the direction of his distant cousin's flower and wood villa, his eyes opened like copper bells, mouth open to stuff eggs, cousin's villa and yard can not be seen, not only the villa and yard can not be seen, the yard in front of the door connected to the asphalt road of the cement road is also only half, to cousin's villa as the center of the circle, fifty meters as the radius of the place, there is nothing left, there is only a deep bottomless pothole. .

Zheng family flower and wood villa around the diameter of a hundred meters on the square circle of all things have disappeared, only to leave a huge deep pit, 110 received the alarm, at first thought that the caller pranks, but when the prank alarm calls more, 110 alarm station attention, sent two consecutive police cars to go to understand the situation.
110 police car arrived, the pothole around the crowd has been full of watching the crowd. Two seemingly sixty-year-old couple is wiping tears at the pothole, while wiping tears and the surrounding crowd to tell the story.
The evening of the township of flowers and trees local television reported this bizarre news, February 15, 2013, the sixth day of the first month of the lunar calendar at 11:20 am, without any signs, the township of flowers and trees of an area of nearly 8,000 square meters of land collapsed, collapsed into the bottom of the bottom of the naked eye can not see the pit, according to the reporter on-site understanding of the accident site on the villa, five workers room and a greenhouse have collapsed into the pothole, villa, two men and a big wolf dog also disappeared with the disappearance of one man identity has been determined to be a twenty-eight-year-old billion flower and wood planting family, the other man unidentified. Two men and a big wolf dog in the villa also disappeared, one of the men's identity has been determined, is a billion dollar twenty-eight-year-old flower and tree planting family, the other man's identity is unknown, according to eyewitnesses at the scene of the missing planting family's cousin described the unidentified man in the early thirties, seems to be a friend of his cousin. In the end what caused such a large surface collapse, the relevant parties are still under investigation.
Behind the moon, 400,000 kilometers away from Earth, a spaceship with an exterior area of eight thousand square meters was quietly moored there. The two U-Star extraterrestrials on the spaceship were looking at the image of the sinkhole and discussing it.
"Ch-ch-check, honey, I'm in trouble again!" The alien seemed guilty.
"There seems to be more than one woe!" The alien who answered was calm, as if accustomed to his companion's furtiveness.
"Hee hee, not a few woes, not just accidentally teleported 8,000 square meters of this space and time to another dimension! Well of course, the ship also made a few rocks fall to Earth as it flew towards the moon."
Spaceships for inter-dimensional space jump flight, from a realm jump to another realm, you must let the two realms of material weight does not change, because the change will cause the lack of material that realm space-time collapse, resulting in the collapse of the space-time space, so the alien spacecraft from the other realm jumped into the twenty-first century on Earth, it is necessary to intercept from the Earth and the spacecraft and other quality of the material to pass over the original interception of the material are Originally, the intercepted material is intercepted from the sparsely populated places to transmit, but this time the alien responsible for this program is distracted to capture the soul of a human being who jumped from a building to commit suicide, and the point coordinates point a wrong number, which should have intercepted the material of the western plateau of the Heavenly Kingdom to intercept the material of the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River.
As for the few stones that fell, it was the few large meteorites that fell on Russian soil. The power of that stone is not too big, the stone caused by the explosion power is only equivalent to the 1945 Hiroshima atomic bomb explosion power of 30 times, the good thing is that the power of the explosion are in the high-altitude release, did not let human beings to enjoy the Jurassic dinosaurs treatment.
"There are two humans, a dog, sixteen goldfish, seven rats, two hibernating snakes, n thousand worm eggs on that matter ...." The bemused alien mechanically reported the beamed away creatures.
"It's all pretty much the same blue planet, it's the same life over there." The hairy alien argued, but wouldn't it be just as easy to live in a different place for Earth creatures.
"You're forgetting one thing, the jump dimension has a time-reversal effect."
"Eh ...." The hairy alien scrunched his neck, finally realizing that he was in trouble, and wondering to what extent Earth creatures were affected by the time-reversal effect, if the time-reversal was too much, it would be hard to tell if the two men would live. Knowing that he may be in trouble, he gave a suicide on Earth to steal the soul of the matter did not mention to his companions, anyway, one of the two Earth souls do not want to live, do not want to live in the soul of the ship specimen containers well, the other let him be reborn (the two unlucky souls is the brocade to add to the flower of the Zhang Jianjun and Hua Pinsu).
In an estate in a small country in the Southeast Asian region of Earth, an international arms kingpin is listening to his men report the news that the betrayer who was given a mandatory kill order has disappeared, his body and bones intact.
"Fell into a deep pit? Then the 100-carat diamond in his hand also fell into a deep pit?" The arms king stormed, that weight of diamonds worth 300-400 million yuan, is the arms dealers a year's income from arms trading, in order to facilitate the black income whitewash, the buyer with diamonds and arms dealers, but unfortunately this sky-high diamonds were stolen by a small thief.
"That pit can't see the bottom, the bottom has seeped water, and the area around the deep pit has been fenced off by the local authorities." Arms King's men had beads of sweat on their foreheads, that pit he had sent people to explore, it was so deep that no one could find people or houses, and more than 100 carats was even more unthinkable.
"Hmph, I knew you had a thousand excuses to justify yourselves!" The King of Arms had suffered heavy losses, and after knowing that he would lose all his earnings for more than a year, he refused to listen to his men's pleadings any longer, and waved his hand for his underlings to take the shivering pursuers out for disposal; the poppies around his villa were in need of fertilizer.

The left doctor of Chu looked at the gift list offered by the merchants of Wu, and his face moved a little. The gift list was very expensive, there were two jacquard cloths, ten south port cloths, a stack of white paper, and a pair of porcelain vases.
"Call the merchant of Wu in!" The left doctor, on the face of the expensive gift list, asked the family servant to lead Wu Mu in, this Wu merchant was very close to the right doctor, and the left doctor was not comfortable in his heart.
"Wu Mu pays his respects to Dr. Zuo!" Wu Mu came in holding an exquisite box, carefully placing it to the side first before respectfully saluting.
"Get up!" Dr. Zuo frowned, what was this merchant doing coming in holding a box and being so careful.
"My lord, please hold back your left and right, I want to enter a rare treasure from my lord." Wu Mu took a step forward and wanted to walk in front of Dr. Zuo to speak quietly, but he was stopped by the house servant.
Dr. Zuo's eyes narrowed slightly. "What rare treasure can't be brought in openly?"
"My lord, this thing is the most precious in Great Qin. I only want to offer it to Your Excellency, I don't want to give it to others." Wu Mu took a few steps back and stood motionless next to the box.
Zuo Daifu sized up Wu Mu, a short and thin middle aged man, such a person would not be an assassin.
"Go down, all of you, and stand outside the door and wait!"
"Yes!"
The house servant promised and withdrew from the door, standing under the eaves of the house waiting for the call. Not long after, only heard a cry of alarm inside the house, the house servant, immediately turned back to rush into the house, but was stopped by Dr. Zuo.
"Don't even come in! Stand away!" Zuo Daifu's voice was stern, and the servant only saw Zuo Daifu protecting something with his sleeve, while the Wu merchant stood far to the side.
Zuo Daifu and the other household servants moved away, still guarding the box on the case table with their hands. "You talk to me inside!"
Dr. Zuo carefully held the box and brought Wu Mu into a secret room. (Why do people in this time and space like to build secret rooms?)
"Where did you find this treasure from?" After entering the secret room, only then did Doctor Zuo carefully open the box and appreciate what was in the box, what was placed in the box was a ball shaped crystal paperweight, the kind that was pure and colorless, with a rose flower type inside.
"It was an overseas person who went to Nambu to sell it, and I spent my entire family fortune to purchase it."
This thing is of course the valley villa to provide, Zheng Yuming originally also wanted to take the ashtray as a gift, was vetoed by Chu Chao Hui, because the villa has only two ashtrays, has been sent off one, and then send off the other, Chu Chao Hui smoking in the villa will not have an ashtray available. Zheng Yuming saw Chu Zhaohui muttering, then casually took out the crystal paperweight in the upstairs study, Wu Mu's head was dazzled for a moment after seeing it for the first time, this thing is too expensive, it can be worth a city.
"What do you want?" Dr. Zuo's eyes couldn't look away, no wonder this merchant asked him to hold back his left and right.
"My lord! Woe to the little man! Please help me, my lord!" Wu Mu fell to his knees with a plop.
"You say what it is." Zuo Daifu was mesmerized by the crystal paperweight and decided in his heart that as long as it wasn't treason, he would help each other.
"The villain has a gap with Dr. Wu Jiang."
"How can I help you when you are at odds with the great doctor of your country? Do you wish to move to Chu? If so, it's too good to be true; you can just move your family here, and I'll guarantee you a lifetime of wealth and prosperity."
"No, the villainous industry is in Wu and cannot leave."
"Then how can I help you?" Zuo Daifu frowned, it's not like he should encourage the King of Chu to attack Wu to destroy a scholar.
"As long as Duke Yong, whom Dr. Jiang has embraced, does not become the king of Wu in the future, I will be safe in Wu." Wu Mu was afraid that Zuo Daifu did not understand, and hastened to add. "Yong's mother consort cajoled the king of Wu to come to Chu to propose marriage for his son, wanting to beg to marry a Chu concubine."
"Oh, you mean to let Gongzi Yong's proposal fall through?" Zuo Daifu nodded his head, the King of Wu wanted to abolish his first son, the Court of Chu had heard about it.
"Good! Please help me, my lord!"
"This is but a small matter, don't worry about going back, with me here, Wu will not be able to beg for a marriage." Zuo Daifu was full of confidence, he did not have the talent to govern the country, but he had the ability to swim in the royal court.
Aimee, the King of Chu's favorite concubine, was sitting on the terrace watching the King of Chu teasing her son. Aimee was one of the King of Chu's favorite concubines in his later years, and the six-year-old son born to her was most loved by the King of Chu. Whenever the King of Chu was free, he would play with this youngest son.
"Madam! Dr. Zuo is here to see you!" The maid gently walked over to Aimee Ji to report.
"Invite him in!" Aimee Ji and Dr. Zuo were closer.
"I beg your pardon, ma'am!"
"Don't be polite, Dr. Zuo, please take a seat, the Great King will be here soon." Aimee Ji was polite to Dr. Zuo.
Zuo Daifu bowed and did not take his seat, but stood beside Aimee Ji and watched out towards the terrace. "The Great King really favors the young prince."
"They say parents love their youngest child!" Aimee Ji hid a smile, with smugness in her eyes.
"Last time, the Great King said again that he wanted to make the youngest son a crown prince." Zuo Daifu appeared to be chatting idly.
"Aren't there ministers against it?" There was despondency in Aimee Ji's eyes.
"The king insists on this, and I can only obey if I am a subject."
When Aimee Ji heard this, she raised her eyes to look at Dr. Zuo, and saw that Dr. Zuo's face was full of sincerity. "Doctor Zuo, if you help me, Aimee will not forget your favor!"
"I will definitely serve the King of Chu with my liver and brain!" Zuo Daifu was very cunning, talking about the King of Chu, but Aimee Ji thought it was the future King of Chu in her ears.
Seeing Aimee Ji's joyful face, Zuo Daifu took another step forward and said softly, "The King of Wu sent an envoy to Chu to seek a marriage for Gongzi Yong."
"Wu wants to marry Chu?" Aimee Ji's face changed when she heard this, there was only one unmarried Ji daughter in Chu, and she was the same mother as the first male son, Ur.
"Yes, the king is preparing to summon the Wu emissary tomorrow."
"Got it! Thank you Dr. Zuo!" Aimee Ji leaned down towards Dr. Zuo in appreciation.
Just then, there was a sudden cry of alarm outside the terrace. Aimee Ji looked outward, only to see the King of Chu flopping to the ground, his mouth full of blood, and the young duchess standing dumbfounded with a rope in his hand in front of him.
"Great King! Great King!" Aimee Ji rushed to the King of Chu, helped him up, and turned her head to scold her son.
"No scolding Missy!" The king of Chu waved his hand to stop, talking leakage. "Missy come, come to father, don't be afraid!"
When the little son was playing with his father, he had a whim to pull a cow with a rope. The king of Chu favored his son, so he held a rope in his mouth and let his son pull it, but he didn't want the little son to fall down and break the king's teeth.
"Father!" The young male instantly jumped into the Chu King's arms and cried loudly.
"The youngest child is not crying!" King Chu patted his son's back and softly comforted him.
The corners of Aimee Ji's mouth couldn't help but curl up as she helped King Chu wipe the blood from his mouth.
That night, the King of Chu stayed over at Aimee Ji's place, and when Aimee Ji undressed and went to bed in front of the King of Chu, the King of Chu suddenly frowned.
"Aimee-ji, why are you bruised at your arm?"
"Your Majesty!" Aimee Ji bowed her head and hung her eyes.
"What's going on?" The King of Chu's voice rose.
"Great King! Please, Your Majesty, stop favoring Missy!" Aimee Ji suddenly covered her face in tears.
"Hmm? What's going on? Is there anyone who won't allow me to love my son?" King Chu's voice was stern.
"O Great King! Please, Your Majesty, think of my mother and son and leave them alive!" Aimee Ji threw herself onto the King of Chu's knees and cried bitterly.
"Say, what exactly happened?" King Chu's forehead was bruised.
"When I met Mr. Ur the day before yesterday, my concubine was a little slow in avoiding him, and then she was pushed aside by Mr. Ur's men. When Mr. Ur walked past my concubine, he even laughed coldly. The Great King now favors the youngest son so much, when the Great King is a hundred years old and Prince Joel ascends to the throne, at that time, where will there be a way for my mother and son to live?" Aimee Ji cried miserably.
"Hmph! That rebellious son will never succeed the throne! I will leave the throne of Chu to the youngest son!" The King of Chu's ruthless voice.
"But Prince Ur will be powerful in the future, and my concubine is afraid." Aimee Ji's crying stopped.
"How can Ur be powerful?" The King of Chu was puzzled, he had always talked coldly about this first son and never gave him any real power, how could Aimee Ji say that he had become powerful?
"The Kingdom of Wu has sent an emissary to ask for marriage, and if Duke Ur's own sister marries the Duke of Wu, won't Duke Ur have something to fall back on?" Aimee Ji said while stealing glances at the Chu King's face with her eyes.
"Hmph! As long as I live for a day, Joel will never think of a day to lend his power!" The King of Chu laughed coldly and vetoed Wu's request for marriage before he even saw the Wu emissary.
What if the minister opposes? He is the highest authority in Chu, and the throne of Chu can only be inherited by the beloved youngest son in the future.
Author's comment: "Ru Zi Cow" is an allusion recorded in "Zuo Zhuan - Lamenting Duke Six Years": Duke Jing of Qi had a concubine son named Tuan, Duke Jing of Qi loved him very much. Once Qi Jing Duke and Tuan were playing together, Qi Jing Duke, as the king of a country, even held a rope in his mouth and let Tuan lead him. Unexpectedly, his son accidentally fell and broke Qi Jing Duke's teeth. Before his death, Duke Jing of Qi ordered Tuan to be the king of the country. After the death of Duke Jing, Chen Xizi wanted to install Duke Yangsheng. Bao Mu, a minister of Duke Jing of Qi, said to Chen Xizi, "Have you forgotten that the ruler was a child cow and broke his teeth? And you are carrying it on your back!" Therefore, the original meaning of "a child's ox" at that time was to express the parents' excessive love for their children.

On the winter solstice, the Emperor of Qin and the lords and lords of all countries held a wax festival to comfort the gods of heaven and earth and the ancestors. The scale of the wax festival was the grandest among all the festivals. This festival was both a sacrifice to the hundred gods and ancestors. Before participating in the festival, all participants were required to purify themselves and eat a vegetarian diet to symbolize purity and piety.
The day of the winter solstice had not yet dawned, Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui took Wei Qing and Huo Sizhong and arrived at Dacheng early. The Wax Festival is different from the Moon Festival, which is a carnival for all the people. The Moon Festival is a carnival for all the people, but the Wax Festival only qualifies the nobles to participate, and the commoners can only watch the ceremony.
The Ulsan ruler Gong Ziguang body wearing a south port jacquard black clothes, head wearing a high crown, waist around the jade belt, waist wear long sword, jade jewelry, feet are a pair of sheepskin cotton boots, full of spring, radiant. He looked at his ancestor's tablet through the green smoke on the sacrificial case and let out a long breath. Thanks to the blessing of his ancestors, Ri Ji's plot to marry Chu was dashed.
Wu's envoy to the state of Chu to propose marriage to the king of Chu had just told him his intention, but the king of Chu refused with a smile, because the state of Chu had no unmarried female concubines. The king of Chu's youngest daughter was promised to the lord of his vassal state, Ba, only half a month before. Wu messenger returned to the state of Chu without any result, and after Ri Ji got the report from Wu messenger, she contracted wind-cold the next day and was bedridden.
When the news of the failure of Ri Ji's wish reached the palace of the king of Ulsan, Duke Ziguang and the officials of the palace were very excited. Because the king of Wu had not listened to the king's ministers and insisted on sending an envoy to Chu to seek a marriage, the shadow that had been hanging over the house of the king of Ulsan had been cleared away. Duke Ziguang worshiped his ancestors and prayed for their blessing again, so that Yi Ji could not recover from her serious illness, or better yet, die.
At the next celebration banquet, the nobles of Dacheng had a good time drinking, and even Wei Shen, who had always been restrained, got drunk. Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui were at the banquet, listening to the ridicule of the nobles of Dacheng towards Ripple Ji, and their refusal to talk about the wisdom of the king of Chu, the two of them couldn't help but look at each other and laugh.
After attending the wax festival, Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui also had a rare vacation. With the New Year coming up in a few days, the several factories and workshops in Nambu and the valley were all on vacation one after another. The village people in Nambu were busy celebrating the New Year, and the slaves in the valley were just as busy celebrating the holiday.
The village people who planted Japonica rice, harvested rice, in addition to their own food, the excess grain are only allowed to be sold to the governor's office, Zheng Chu two people will promote high-yield crops in the Dacheng area, but will not spread these high-yield grain seeds to other vassal states. They are now only tied to a boat with the Ulsan Monarch, and if the high yielding grain crops were to spread out and raise the power of other places, Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui intuitively felt that it was not good. The reasoning of big fish eating small fish told them that when Nanbu was still a tadpole, the surrounding vassal states had better not be big fish. If the neighboring countries were allowed to become powerful, Wu would be in danger, and once Wu was in danger, Nambu would be unstable. Nambu needed time to develop, and Chu Chao Hui's armed forces needed time to train. The high yield of grain in the valley, the later the word gets out the better for Nambu.
The purchase price offered by the governor's office was very high, and the villagers did not object to the rule of not selling japonica rice to outsiders. Some villagers even felt that selling all the japonica rice to the governor's office and using the money from the sale of the grain to buy corn and wheat was very cost-effective, as the price of japonica rice was half of that of corn and wheat. When the villagers sold all the Japonica rice and bought back other grains as rations, they could get a lot of gold coins in their hands, which were enough for them to have a good Spring Festival.
Before all the workers of the factories and workshops in Nambu took their New Year's vacation, they all received the New Year's goods from the factories and workshops. The New Year's goods were purchased by Wu Da's organization, including meat and fish, and ordinary cotton cloth from the textile factory was also distributed as New Year's goods, with each worker receiving enough cotton cloth to make a suit. Village people who did not work in the factory and workshops could buy ordinary cotton cloth from the textile factory for half the price, and those refugees from outside the village could also enjoy buying half-price cotton cloth.
Most of the refugees who stayed in Nambu came from the Tang Dynasty, and these people were instructed by Zheng Yuming to Wu Da to disrupt their kinship relationships and separate them to build temporary housing around the village. Zheng Yuming did not want a big clan to emerge in Nambu village, it is too easy for people with the same surname and the same place to gang up and hold together. Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui hoped that the village people and refugees would only have the concept of 'I am a Nambu person' in their hearts in the future, and did not want to see the emergence of such clan concepts as 'I am a member of the Wu clan, the Peng clan, or the X clan'.
Where Nambu was burned, houses were being built, all brick houses, two-story structures, with flat brick walls; later, when the economy grows, these houses will have additional floors added to them, so the foundations and walls underneath must be strong.
As the wharf became increasingly busy, the original wharf facilities became rudimentary. After the fall harvest, Zheng Yuming repaired the wharf as well, and the repaired wharf was able to moor more ships and make it more convenient to load and unload goods.
The twenty material ship built by the wood factory has been launched, and it has been test sailed once in the Yangtze River, and after the successful test sail, the ship has been snatched and ordered by Wu Mu. Wu Mu is not going to go out at the end of the year, and will wait for the Spring Festival to go to Chu to do business, this cost him 10,000 gold coins to buy the 20 material ship, is quietly moored at the pier, attracting people passing by to stop and watch.
The first wooden ship of the wood factory was successfully built, Zheng Yuming was ready to separate a shipyard from the wood factory, specializing in the manufacture of large ships, after the Spring Festival, this new shipyard would build a large ship of fifty materials, and later on, when the large ship of fifty materials was built, then a large ship of one hundred materials would be built, and then two hundred materials, but there was not a lot of wood that had been shade-dried for three years, and the wood nearby that could be used to build a ship was pretty much purchased by Nambu, and in order to build a large ship of a couple of hundred materials, one would have to To build a large ship of several hundred tons, one would have to wait for the wood cut down in the valley to dry for three years. In this miserable era, the transportation is based on the natural out of the dirt road, there is a big boat, the South Port goods through the waterway, can be more convenient to sell to faraway places.
The number of slaves in the valley had reached more than twelve hundred. After the winter solstice, the slaves took a vacation to prepare for the Spring Festival, the slaves who worked as laborers received their wages, the slaves who worked as farmers received their dividends, and every slave received a piece of cotton cloth to make new clothes. The slaves had money in their hands, but they could not go out of the valley to buy things, in order to meet the slaves' purchasing needs, a cheap store was opened in the valley, which was full of daily necessities for slaves in need to buy.
Domesticated pigs, goats, chickens and ducks in the valley were slaughtered, fish from the valley's rivers were salvaged with nets, and the uneaten fish were processed and hung under the eaves of the house to dry. Slave soldiers who stopped training took other slaves on vacation to hunt around, and the wild game caught enriched the table.
The canteen system in the valley began to change, somewhat similar to the rationing in the Celestial Kingdom, which stipulated the number of grains per slave per month, and you could eat in the canteen, or take rice from the canteen and go back to your own place to open a small stove. Some of the slaves who had family members lived in mud huts and started to build mud stoves, and as long as there were some conditions, people still liked to live their own little lives.
Eating problem for single slaves, they still feel that the canteen is convenient, after all, when it comes to the eating hour, clip on the bowl and chopsticks can eat ready-made, the food in the valley is too much better than what they originally ate, plus the female slaves in charge of the canteen cook very seriously, not the latter days like cooking pig food, slaves have no complaints about the food, although there are some slaves who cook in their own mud huts, but the majority of them still like to dine in the canteen.
After the winter solstice, the first wedding feast was held in the valley. The honorable teacher Fan Zin, at the age of twenty-three, married the seventeen-year-old eldest daughter of the Ge carpenter's family. Van Zin's marriage ceremony was held in an unorthodox manner.
The marriage system in this time and place follows the three major principles of the Western Zhou Dynasty, namely monogamy, no marriage with the same surname, and the order of parents. Monogamy means that there is only one legal wife and concubines are allowed. The reason for not marrying a person of the same surname was both ethical in terms of bloodline, genetic in terms of reproduction, and political in terms of patriarchal law. The ruling class ruled the world by the patriarchal system in the hope of utilizing the bond of marriage to achieve the purpose of uniting the nobles of different castes to strengthen their ruling power. Under the patriarchal system, a child's marriage must be decided by his or her parents and completed through the intermediary of a matchmaker; otherwise, it would be an indecent and illegal act, known as "lewd running away", and would not be recognized by the clan or society.
The establishment of the marriage relationship is cumbersome and must go through a process of six rites. For the dissolution of a marriage, a woman has seven to go and three not to go. These restrictive conditions reflect the humane side of the ancient ritual system.
According to normal thinking, Fan Jin's wedding should have been completed in accordance with the customs and systems of the time, but this Fan Jin's thinking was a little more active, and he went to seek an audience with Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui, requesting that the marriage be completed in accordance with the customs of the Bermuda Kingdom. Fan Jin's reasoning was that his master was a Bermudian, and he should also be a Bermudian subject.
Zheng Yuming was stunned when he heard Fan Jin's request. Not to mention the fact that there is no Bermuda this country, even if there is, Fan Jin such a statement behind the far-reaching meaning ah, Fan Jin is a Wu, but he does not want to be a Wu, to be a Bermuda, which shows that he only recognized Zheng Chu two people, rise to politics, is the blatant treason. This time people's national concept is not strong, but still have.
"Why do you want to be a Bermudian?" Chu Chao Hui stroked his chin with a smirk on his face.
"Your Honor, Jin feels that being a Bermudian is more like a human being!" Fan Jin this is a personal experience, the original artist career, not to say dignified, more humiliation, and life are not guaranteed. After coming to the valley, Zheng Chu two people just make rules and regulations, everything in accordance with the rules and regulations to do things, slaves violate the law, according to the rules and regulations of punishment. The two never treat them with their own likes and dislikes, Fan Jin vaguely felt that Zheng Chu's two practices may be the Baimu country's treatment of its people, living in such a system of rules and regulations, Fan Jin felt safe and at ease.
"More like a human being?" Zheng Yuming re-measured this half-toned teacher, Fanjin said this, could it be that when the two of them were granting guests at night, they had subliminally raised Fanjin's ideological awareness?
"Jin from the age of twelve years later, with the artist master around selling art to make a living, at first learning the art is not good, life is difficult, after the skill is good, often perform for the noble lord, the reward is more, but there is no life security." Fan Zin's eyes reddened as he spoke. "One of my senior brother who stepped on the heights, when he performed, he missed and fell from the high ladder, the banquet master was furious on the spot, he thought that my senior brother had lost his face, and ordered the household servants to beat my senior brother half to death, the poor junior brother was only sixteen years old, and he died after a day and a night of pain."
Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui looked at each other, and they were silent.
"Tsu was exiled and innocent, that nobleman had originally died from catching a wind chill, but the nobleman's family insisted that it was Tsu's fault." At that time, Fan Tsu felt that he was just an ant, something that could be casually pinched by the nobleman.
"Fan Jin, it is impossible for us to go back to Bermuda, if you want to be a Bermudian, you can only do it in your heart." Zheng Yuming cautioned Fan Jin, if Fan Jin's words were to be known by the aristocrats of Dacheng, Wei Shen would immediately suspect them of having evil intentions.
"I know!" Fan Zin wiped his eyes, happy in his heart that he was truly accepted by his Lord's family. "I ask the two lords to organize a wedding for my villain in accordance with the customs of the Bermuda Kingdom."
"Our wedding customs there are very different from here, does your father-in-law, Carpenter Ge, have a problem with that?"
"No, the villain came to request this after discussing it with his father-in-law."
"When we write out the steps to get married in Bermuda at night, if you think it's appropriate, we'll hold it according to these steps." Zheng Yuming scratched his head, were the steps written in Western or Chinese style?
Zheng Yuming and Chu Chao Hui have never been married, that night, the two discussed half a day, the twenty-first century Western and Chinese wedding forms rubbed together, an imported wedding forms in this continent was born, this wedding way in the future to become mainstream. How many years later, archaeological experts on the end of the great Qin wedding organized in the form of a sudden huge change puzzled, a variety of insights, has been arguing, this thesis feeds a large number of scholars and experts.

The day after Fan Jin's wedding, Dajiang returned to the valley from Wu Wangdu, who had come back for the Spring Festival. Yu Kui did not come back, but only asked Dajiang to bring back a letter.
Yu Kui's letter first expresses his gratitude to his two lords, thanking Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui for sending him the New Year's goods, and states that he will do his best to move around the capital of Wu for his lords, and has now become a guest at the residence of Dr. Jiang.
The Spring Festival is a good time to make good relations with the king of Wu, this time can not be let go, so Yu Kui said not to go back to Nambu New Year's Eve, next year in the spring, he will think of a trip back to the city of Dar. In addition, the letter is also attached to the latest news of Ripple Ji, Chu refused to marry this matter, only let Ripple Ji in bed for three days, three days later, Ripple Ji on the full state of resurrection, this year's Spring Festival, all the festivities in the Palace Exam matters are still chaired by the Ripple Ji to organize.
Zheng Yuming and Chu Zhaohui knew that Wu's request for marriage had been rejected even earlier than the King's Court of Wu. Their news came directly from the Chu Royal Court, the Wu Royal Court only knew when the emissaries returned home, and Dacheng knew even later, waiting for the ears and eyes of the Wu Royal Capital to send a letter back.
As soon as Zheng Chu and the two of them knew the exact news, they decided that they would properly console the great meritocracy that had gone undercover in the royal capital of Kang. Yu Kui is a man who is not greedy for money, he only wants to have a bright master, he only wants to have a stage to implement his talent, and of course, what he wishes for the most is to bring down the King's Court of Chu, and to take revenge for the misfortune of his family's entire family. For such a talented person, Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui, in addition to letting go of everything in Wudu City and providing a constant stream of logistical support, in addition to the subtle ways to send care.
Before the winter solstice, Yu Kui in the capital city of Kang received a mule cart of things sent by the South Port, no gold, silver and jewelry on the mule cart, only clothing and daily necessities and New Year's goods. Clothing is in accordance with his body sewing, look inconspicuous, but inside there is a dry world. The most representative is an undershirt, fabric peculiar, hold in the hand is very light, wear on the body is like wearing a stove, undershirt inside is down.
This time and space to make down is very laborious, the down produced has a smell that can not be eliminated. With down, there is no fabric for down, Nambu can't produce down fabric that doesn't run hair. So know that down is very warm, but can not make the twenty-first century down jacket.
The undershirt that was sent to Yu Kui was converted from one of Zheng Yuming's down jackets. The body was converted into an undershirt, the two sleeves were converted into knee pads, and the converted knee pads were also sent over, Kangcheng was much colder than the Dacheng area, and with these two types of clothing to protect from the cold, Yu Kui would not freeze.
The stove-like clothes made Yu Kui feel the Lord's strong concern, and the new year's goods sent to Yu Kui were even more comforting. There were several jars of high-grade green wine in the New Year's goods, which was Yu Kui's favorite wine. There was also an altar of crimson wine, which was sweet and sour and very tasty. This kind of wine was wine, made from the grapes in the villa's yard, and there were only three altars in total. One altar was for Zheng Chu's two personal use, one altar was given to Ulsan Jun, and the last altar was given to Yu Kui, who was a good wine drinker. In addition to the wine, there was also japonica rice, gnocchi and dim sum, glutinous rice and japonica rice mixed and ground into rice flour to make gnocchi, gnocchi wrapped with different fillings. The snacks were pumpkin and sweet potato cakes.
Jung Yu-ming emphasized on the secret letter sent along with the mule train that the annual goods on the mule train were for Yu Kuei's own enjoyment, and that Yu Kuei was not allowed to give them to the nobles of the capitol as a solicitation gift.
Yu Kui received the gift, read Zheng Yuming's handwritten secret letter, on the spot in tears, after the loss of loved ones, no one cared about him again, Zheng Yuming and Chu Chaohui heart to send things, so that Yu Kui revisited the warmth of loved ones.
Dazhuang back to the valley, Dazhuang father rushed to find a matchmaker to go to Ge carpenter's home for his son's marriage, ready to this year's Spring Festival before the wedding, next year after the spring harvest to his son to finish the marriage.
Dazhuang didn't make it to Fanjin's alternative wedding, and he was very interested in the Bermuda wedding that his old man was talking about, thinking that he would have a Bermuda-style wedding next year when he got married. As his own old man's description is not three-dimensional enough, Dajiang goes directly to the groom, Fan Jin, to inquire.
"Asking for a kiss is a bit simple and not discreet enough!" Da Zhuang scratched his head, his hair was already a bit long, almost ready for pigtails. The slaves were forced to shave their hair when they entered the valley, and after that, there were no requirements for their hair, leaving it as long or short as they wished. Unless the hair grows lice again, then it has to be shaved again.
The wedding of the Da Qin nobles is quite elaborate, roughly to go through the six main steps of Nacai, ask the name, Naji, Naji, please period, pro welcome, etc., but the common people do not have the energy and financial resources to toss, simplified a lot, but not as simple as Bermuda.
"I think this is good, this couple is neutralized before they are married, so that they can live better in the future."
