Ri Ji's actions really attracted public indignation, Tai Fu knew that Zheng Yuming had started the incident under the identity of Gong Zi Ming, and did not favor Ri Ji to expose it. After the great victory in Ulsan, Taifu saw that Zheng Yuming did not take the throne directly, so he waited for Chu Chaohui to drive the Tang King out of Wu before saying anything. However, when some of the nobles of the royal capital conspired to draw him in, Tai Fu could not sit still. After the elimination of his greatest rival, many of the nobles of the royal court and the feudal lords began to doubt Zheng Yuming's identity and used it as an excuse to seek personal gain for themselves.
Taifu one does not want the country to be in turmoil again, the second does not want to attract the prying eyes of the surrounding vassal states due to Zheng Yuming's false prince status, after all, there are always those who take advantage of the fire in the world while you're sick and want to take advantage of your life.
The meaning of the last part of the words of Tai Fu contains a kind of transaction, as long as Zheng Yuming does not become the king of Wu, the future king of Wu will be chosen by Zheng Yuming, not only will Tai Fu not reveal Zheng Yuming's false identity of Gong Zi Ming, but will also support Zheng Yuming to use this identity to assist the future king of Wu.
"In that case, it's best for Wu if Yuming doesn't succeed the throne?" Zheng Yuming's voice was slightly cold.
"Not bad!" Tai Fu's attitude was insistent.
"Who do you think can be the Crown Prince?" Zheng Yuming narrowed his eyes and asked, always soft eyes rarely have killing intent, if Taifu recommended candidates to him, Zheng Yuming today will not let Taifu live out of the palace.
"I believe in Councilor Zheng's discerning eye for talent." Tai Fu looked sincere.
"What if Yuming-ri is a fool?" Jung Yuming laughed softly.
"With Councilor Zheng assisting him, there's no harm in the State King being pure." Tai Fu was silent for a moment before replying resolutely.
Zheng Yuming stared at Tai Fu for a long time without saying anything, for the matter of the establishment of the reserves, the old man really did not bring selfishness to the negotiations.
"Yuming will have to deliberate on this matter. I can't answer Tai Fu until three days later."
"The old man will close his door when he returns." Immediately, Tai Fu assured Zheng Yuming that until Zheng Yuming had replied, Tai Fu would not come into contact with anyone.
Tai Fu's reputation in Wu is too high, and now that the royal capital is in an eventful time, if Tai Fu dies violently without any reason, it will even become an excuse for the nobles with dissenting hearts to conspire against him. Zheng Yuming weighs the pros and cons, and before making a decision, he lets Tai Fu return to his residence in peace, and only orders Huang Zhong to send people to keep a secret watch on the surroundings of Tai Fu's residence.
Taifu returned to the house, to keep his promise, the door is closed, neither see guests, nor go out, at home to wait for Zheng Yuming to make a decision. And Zheng Yuming did not have to think for three days, because in the early morning of the next day, the northern part of Wu came two news, two news is a good and a bad. These two opposite news prompted Zheng Yuming to make a decision in advance.

Wei and Tang are both vassal states bordering Wu. Tang is located in the north east of Wu, while Wei is in the north west of Wu. Wei is a landlocked state with three neighboring states. A small portion of its territory is bordered by Tang, while most of its territory is sandwiched between Wu and Zhao.
The state of Wei was not as large as the state of Tang, and was considered a small to medium-sized vassal state among the Qin vassal states, and its power was not comparable to that of the powerful vassal states of Zhao and Wu. However, Wei's luck was similar to that of Chen, which was sandwiched between Chu and Zhao, because the two vassal states did not want to increase the danger of having their borders directly connected with the stronger ones, and neither of them allowed the other to use military force against Wei, so Wei, a small and weak vassal state, was spared from being annexed by the stronger ones.
The fiefdom of the Northern Marquis was adjacent to the state of Wei, a plain with rich grass and water, which was the main horse-herding area of the state of Wu. Although the king of Wu imposed a large amount of tribute every year, Bei Hou had some money in his hand by trading the high quality horses on the plains with the vassal states that were short of horses, so Bei Hou raised 5,000 soldiers privately in his fiefdom. Zeng You and Wei Qing led 2,000 cavalry and 3,000 infantry to attack the North Marquis, which had about the same strength, but they did not have the advantage in numbers and were at a disadvantage of fighting as a guest army.
Wei Qing looked at the caravan at the end of the line slowly transporting grain and grass, feeling that this speed was too slow to walk to the Northern Marquis' fiefdom, which would give the Northern Marquis plenty of time to prepare for the battle. "Master Zeng, Wei Qing wants to lead the cavalry in a light run to catch the Northern Marquis off guard!"
"You kid is thinking of a surprise victory, right?" Zeng You was a bit envious of Wei Qing, being seven or eight years younger than him, yet his official position in the army was already almost equal to his.
After Ulsan occupied the royal city, the number of troops expanded dramatically, Ulsan's army establishment has been expanded from battalion to division, Zeng You, who has military achievements, jumped two ranks from battalion commander to brigade commander, Wei Qing even jumped three ranks, from company commander to the deputy brigade commander.
"Your Excellency has taught us so many strategies, that is, he wants us to apply them flexibly to actual combat. Look at this wind starting to turn, I reckon the weather will get cold in a few days, if it snows then, marching in the mud with provisions and rations will be even slower. It would be even more unfavorable for us to march wearily on a snowy day to go fight the Northern Marquis soldiers." Wei Qing nodded his head in acknowledgement. "So we can only win with speed and surprise."
"You've considered it well, then pick the cavalry to move quickly, and I'll have the troops step up the pace." Zeng You looked up at the sky with thick clouds and nodded his head in agreement with Wei Qing's plan.
Wei Qing selected six hundred strong cavalry, each cavalry is equipped with two horses, rotating horseback riding day and night, only one day and one night rushed to the northern marquis fiefdom, almost to the northern marquis fief Qucheng, this far raiding army also caught the northern marquis inserted in the king's capital of the spy, after interrogation, the spy explains that he is the northern marquis transmission of the news of the king's capital to send troops.
After Wei Qing learned that the Northern Marquis had not yet received the message that the king's capital had sent out troops to crush him, he was even more certain of the success of his plan to attack from afar.
After the Northern Marquis learned that the Ulsan army had quickly broken the royal capital and that Yi Ji and Gongzi Yong had set themselves on fire in the royal palace, he began to panic in his heart. He originally wanted to take advantage of the two sides were fighting hard, pick up a cheap first self-reliance, and then send a letter to the vassal state king to reveal Zheng Yuming's false identity of the Prince, so that he can stand on the moral high ground to denounce Zheng Yuming, so that his self-reliance is not only justified, but also to attract the opposition to Zheng Yuming's forces to join the cause. These plans were shattered by the lightning breakthrough of the Ulsan army.
In a panic, the Northern Marquis immediately sent a letter to the Prince of Qin and the lords of the vassals, in which he declared that Zheng Yuming was an impostor, and requested the Prince of Qin and the lords of the vassals to come out to administer justice, and that the throne of the Kingdom of Wu could not be occupied by an unidentified hypocrite.
After the founding of Great Qin, the feudal system was practiced, and the land, together with the people, was granted to the royal family, the meritorious officials and the nobles, who were the rulers of the feudal states, that is to say, the rulers of the vassal states now. These state rulers and the Great Qin son of heaven with a surname of nearly half, they really can be said to be three hundred years ago is a family.
Just because half of the monarchs of the Great Qin world are of the same ancestor, if a foreigner wanted to steal the throne of Wu, Bei Hou was convinced that by biting Zheng Yuming's false dukedom, he would have the actual support of the lords, and Great Qin ruled the kingdom by bloodline.
After the Northern Marquis's letter was sent, the Kingdom of Zhao was the first to take action, not only did Prince Xuan of Zhao immediately send an emissary to reply to the Northern Marquis, he also gathered his soldiers and horses and marched to the State of Wei, through which he went to the Northern Marquis's fiefdom to help his fellow clan members of three hundred years ago.
Wei Qing rushed with six hundred cavalrymen to take cover outside of the Northern Marquis' fief, Qu City. Because the Northern Marquis had not yet received the news that Azure Mountain's army had left the royal capital to crush him, Qu City did not close its gates during the day. Wei Qing sent a dozen or so men to sneak into the city, killed the guards at the southern gate after dark, seized the gate and lowered the drawbridge for the cavalry to enter the city. After entering the city safely, Wei Qing did not send people to occupy the city gate, but led all the cavalry to kill the Northern Marquis residence. Wei Qing's plan was to capture and kill the Northern Marquis before the latter was disturbed. Without a feudal lord in Qu City, the enemy's morale would naturally dissipate, and Wei Qing only needed to hold out for two days with his cavalry in the Northern Marquis' residence, and then when Zeng You arrived with his army, the city of Qu City, which was devoid of any resistance, would naturally fall into the palm of his hand.
When the Ulsan cavalry killed the Northern Marquis' residence, the Northern Marquis was entertaining Zhao's envoys with the fief's nobles, and in the midst of pushing cups and exchanging drinks, shouts of murder rang out from the residence. The Northern Marquis was killed in the chaos, and half of the nobles and the Zhao envoys were captured alive.
Relying on the high and thick courtyard wall of the Northern Marquis' residence, Wei Qing blocked the attack of the soldiers of Qu City, and held on until Zeng You attacked the city with a large force, before Wei Qing picked the head of the Northern Marquis on a bamboo pole and showed it to the public. Seeing that the feudal lord was dead, the soldiers of Qu City 'coaxed' and dispersed, and the surviving nobles with a small number of soldiers opened the gates and abandoned the city to Zhao.
The good news that Zheng Yuming received is that the Northern Marquis has been executed and Qu City is under control. The bad news is that Crown Prince Xuan of Zhao has already sent troops and is borrowing a route from Wei to push into the border of Wu. Along with the news, there is also a messenger from Zhao to Qu City.
Zheng Yuming carefully interrogated the Zhao messenger, closed the door and contemplated for half a day, sent people to order Wei Qing and Zeng You stationed in Qucheng to defend the border, told Wei Ren to strengthen the vigilance of the royal city, assigned Guo Si with two thousand men and horses back to the city of Dacheng, and gave Chu Chao Hui pigeon to send a secret letter, to do all of these things, Zheng Yuming late at night to visit Taifu, and Taifu has been in secret talks until the dawn of the day.
The next day, Tai Fu began to go out of the house door activities. Zheng Yuming summoned the ministers to discuss the matter, Tai Fu no longer pretends to be sick, and no longer say nothing during the discussion, but seriously help Zheng Yuming to deal with the political affairs. The ministers and nobles in the royal capital all thought that Tai Fu had decided to appoint Zheng Yuming as the King of Wu, and the underground activities of some dissident nobles and feudal lords slowed down immediately.
In the first half of November, the first snow fell in Wu, the temperature in Kang dropped below zero, and a fireplace was raised in the palace where Zheng Yuming was.
Zheng Yuming was reading a war report in his hand, and the wood lying lazily at his feet suddenly climbed up and ran to the entrance of the great hall to wait for something.
Low voices spoke from outside the hall, and after a while the palace doors were opened and a snowman came in from outside the hall, bringing in white snowflakes and cold air.
"Chaohui? Why are you back?" Jung Yuming stood up, and the person in front of him was instantly recognizable even though his eyebrows and eyelashes, which were exposed outside of his cloak, were whitened by snow.
Chu Chao Hui unclasped his cloak and patted off the snowflakes stained on his hair and eyebrows, his hair did not stay long like Zheng Yuming's, it was still shaved into a short hair style. "Receiving a secret letter from a flying pigeon, can I not come back?"
Chu Chao Hui's face did not have a smile, this is the expression that the two people have never had in private, Zheng Yuming knows in his heart that Chu Chao Hui is like this for what.
"Change your clothes first?" Zheng Yuming realized that the clothes under Chu Chao Hui's cloak were already half wet, and hurriedly helped Chu Chao Hui bring clothes to replace them. Zheng Yuming calculated the time in his heart and figured out that Chu Chao Hui was speeding back to King City day and night as soon as he received the secret letter.
"Tell me, why did you change your mind about not being the King of Wu?" Zheng Yuming's attentiveness did not loosen the expression on Chu Chao Hui's face as he changed his clothes and sat by the fireplace and began to chastise Zheng Yuming.
"Look at these." Zheng Yuming handed a few sheets of paper to Chu Chao Hui.
"Thumbs up! What a dog bites a rat and meddles in its own business, why did these vassal lords not stop Wu's domestic affairs earlier? Where did they all go when Ripple Ji was in rebellion?" Chu Chao Hui sneered after reading it. In his hand was the bottom of the letters from the Northern Marquis to the Prince of Qin and the vassal states, the latest movements of the Zhao army. Chu Zhaohui now deeply hates Da Qin's feudal system, he let most of Da Qin's vassal states have blood ties, and with blood ties, interfering in the internal affairs of other countries has become a justifiable reason.
"I think that without us, Gongzi Yong's throne won't last long, and there are many nobles in Wu who disown Gongzi Yong's throne who will rise up against it, and those who have evil intentions from the surrounding vassal lords will take the opportunity to send out troops. Wu will most likely end up being carved up by purposeful vassal states."
Zheng Yuming sat down next to Chu Chaohui, nowadays the situation of Wu is spelled out by Chu Chaohui's military talent, he said in the secret letter that he wants to give up the throne, of course Chu Chaohui will not be happy.
"You don't want to give the vassal states an excuse to rise up and intervene because you're afraid I won't be able to defeat them?" Chu Chao Hui pressed both of his hands on Zheng Yuming's shoulders, and his face looked relieved.
"I believe you can defeat any enemy." Zheng Yuming shook his head.
"Then why did you still choose not to inherit the throne?" Chu Chao Hui frowned.
"What did you say when you initially trained fifty slave soldiers in the valley?" Zheng Yuming did not answer Chu Chao Hui directly.
"The initial training of fifty slave soldiers is to produce the seed from which the framework of the army will later be built."
"Chaohui, your plan came to fruition, that group of slave soldiers are now officers, like Zhou Cheng and Ma Ren, they can now hold their own."
"That's for sure, in order to train them, I've drained my heart and soul." Chu Chao Hui was proud, not only did he train these slave soldiers in combat, he also taught them to read and write, and taught them strategy, these fifty slave soldiers, he trained them all as future generals.
"With these fifty slave soldiers as a framework, we have nearly four thousand elite soldiers, and these four thousand elite soldiers can be worth twenty thousand soldiers of any country in Great Qin." Zheng Yuming continued to chatter.
Chu Chao Hui, however, suddenly had an epiphany, "Yuming, what are you trying to say?"
"At the battle of Ulsan-do-guchi, twenty-three of these elite soldiers died, fifty-two were slightly and seriously wounded, thirty-eight of whom were cured and returned to the army, while the other fourteen were seriously wounded and disabled and retired from the army. At the battle of Wangdu, two hundred and forty-six died, three hundred and seventy-one were wounded, fifty-six returned to the army, and the others are still being treated. The battle of Qucheng, attrition of seventy or so. Not counting the number of attrition from the elite soldiers in the conquering army, so far, more than six hundred of our carefully trained soldiers have left the ranks." Zheng Yuming's voice was low, these casualties were only those of the three thousand elite soldiers in Nambu and the valley.
"Yuming, everything has a price to pay." Chu Chao Hui is in a low mood, three thousand elite soldiers are now left with two thousand three hundred, the quality of these elite soldiers is not as good as the first batch of trained slave soldiers, but they are all martial arts and intellectual comprehensive cultivation, after a few wars, these elite soldiers are more veteran and brave in combat, and every one of them can be the skeleton of the army in the future.
"Of course I know that we can't have our ideal country without sacrifices, but I'm afraid of tossing all these embers out. Chaohui, not only am I afraid of tossing them out, I'm also afraid of dragging down the Nambu and Valley economy that we have so reluctantly built up. Nambu and Dacheng need a peaceful environment to develop, and Wu needs time to recover." Zheng Yuming wasn't worrying blindly, if the neighboring vassal states used his status as an excuse to invade, Wu would be plunged into endless war. He and Chu Chao Hui were not yet truly powerful.
Chu Chao Hui heard and understood. "So you want to retreat and set up a puppet to be the King of Wu?"
"Yes, I'm going to give Wu Guo a puppet king, and not only do I want this to happen in my lifetime, I want this form to continue as an institution."
"Constitutional monarchy?" Chu Chao Hui's eyes lit up and a smile appeared on his face.
"Not bad, it's this kind of Void Monarch Republic."
"This can be much harder than you being a great king." Chu Chao Hui stretched his waist, he rode from the front line for two consecutive days day and night, his body has long been exhausted, after asking Zheng Yuming's plan, Chu Chao Hui was sleepy and fell asleep crookedly on top of the soft collapse.
Zheng Yuming helped Chu Chaohui cover his quilt and gazed at him for a while before saying quietly to the candlelight, "If I become a king, I will be the biggest obstacle to a democratic republic in the future."
Author's Note: Xiao Zheng's ideal is to build a democratic and republican country, this kind of ideal is not to say that he thinks like this, immediately go to realize. This has to be guided according to the general social environment at that time and the economic development in the future, the guidance must be gradual and orderly, Xiao Zheng's whole life will work hard for this.

At the end of November, on a mountainside at the border of Wei, Zhao Prince Xuan was riding on his horse and looking southeast. In the distance, more than 50 miles away is Qu City, the destination he originally wanted to go. Now, because the Northern Marquis was killed and lost his food supplies and camping place, and because of the sudden cold weather and heavy snow, the Zhao army had to stop at a small city on the border of Wei.
"Crown Prince, the Northern Marquis is too incompetent, a Qu city was taken over by a few hundred people." Zhao Wu Zai hailed his horse and patted it to Zhao Xuan's side, Qu City nobles fled to the Zhao army camp to report the news of the city's fall, 20,000 Zhao troops rushed day and night to recapture the city, but were blocked by a heavy snowfall at the border. The city of Qu has already stationed 5,000 Wu soldiers, plus 1,000 or 2,000 defected Qu soldiers, relying on the high city walls, which can easily keep the Zhao army out of the city gates in windy and snowy weather.
"Alas, this Falling Goose Governor seems to be lucky, even the heavens are helping him." Zhao Xuan's eyes looked greedily into the distance.
If his cousin Prince Zhao succeeded to the throne of Wu, Qu City and several surrounding cities would be included in the territory of the State of Zhao. If the Northern Marquis hadn't died, and the Zhao army had helped the Northern Marquis take over the throne, these places would have been part of the Zhao Kingdom. Unfortunately, the Northern Marquis was too crippled to last until the Zhao army entered the fiefdom and died.
"Report to the Crown Prince! King Wei's messenger seeks an audience." A soldier rode in from the garrison to report.
"Crown Prince, the King of Wei should be sending grain and grass to our army." Zhao Wuzhai laughed after hearing this.
Zhao Xuan laughed loudly, "How dare he not obediently send grain and grass to the army? Wu is taking care of itself, and Wu is no longer a dependency for him to gamble on!"
Zhao Wuzhai's eyes twinkled as he stepped forward to offer his advice, "Crown Prince, when the snow melts and you capture Qu City, why don't you return to your division and annex Wei?"
"If Wu has stabilized domestically, and the Wu army is fighting the Tang army and winning, our army can't feel at ease taking Qu City, as for Wei..." Zhao Xuan pondered for a while and shook his head, the king of Wei is now pleasing all sorts of people, he couldn't find a reason to destroy Wei for a while.
Zhao Xuan now hoped that the King of Tang would fight a little and not be as unbearable as Ripple Ji and Bei Hou. What he hoped for most was that Wu and Tang would fall into a tug-of-war like Lu and Qi, if that happened, Wu would not be able to manage to the northwest after its military power was pulled, and Zhao would not only be able to swallow the Northern Marquis' fiefdom in peace, but would also be able to find excuses to pocket Wei, Wu's strategic buffer state, later on.
Zhao Xuan and Wu Zai returned from the sloping land to the barracks to receive the envoys of Wei, who had been sent by the King of Wei's youngest son, Sui, and an old courtier.
"Father said that your country has been traveling hard for great justice, and sent Yi to send some grain and grass and other belongings, please Prince Jun smile." Wei Shi is only eighteen or nine years old, his demeanor seems slightly childish, before he went on the mission, the King of Wei repeatedly instructed Wei Shi to be careful and humble in front of Zhao Xuan, and must not anger the Prince of Zhao, causing Wei Shi to be nervous in his heart when he saw Zhao Xuan instead.
"Thank you for your thoughts, Wei Jun, Xuan will just smile." Zhao Xuan had a kind face.
The old minister of Wei hastened to present the list of treats.
Zhao Xuan opened the gift list and looked at it, it listed enough grain and grass for the Zhao army to consume for a month, many gold, silver, jewels, brocade and silk, and lastly six maids of honor and two messengers.
"The military camp is full of rough-handed Huben, our Great King is worried that the Crown Prince Jun's living and living without the use of a suitable subordinate, so he carefully selected a few maids and attendants, how about the Crown Prince Jun take a look at it?" The old Wei courtier said curtly.
Zhao Xuan smiled slightly, realizing that these maids and attendants were not here to take care of his life and living, but were specially prepared by the King of Wu for him to use as a bed warmer.
"Wei Jun has taken the trouble!"
Although Wei is not very large, it has always been rich in beauty, the six maids of honor are all charming, and the two attendants have clear faces and red lips. After Zhao Xuan glanced through them one by one, there was a kind of foolishness in his heart, and he couldn't help but secretly praise the soil and water of Wei Kingdom for raising people. Satisfied with the gifts sent by the King of Wei, Zhao Xuan set up a banquet to entertain Wei to treat the emissaries, and let the beauty sent by Wei perform music at the banquet.
When Wei Shi saw that Zhao Xuan was very kind to him and spoke in a civilized and polite manner, not at all like the sinister and brutal manner described by his own father, his expression could not help but relax, and he was no longer formal at the banquet, and he was in the mood to enjoy the food and wine.
Zhao Xuan was reclining on top of the reclining couch, propping his head up with one hand and lightly sipping from a wine cup in the other. Six maids were singing and dancing, their pretty faces and soft waists attracted the attention of everyone in the banquet. Zhao Xuan glanced towards Wei Shi's seat and the corner of his mouth couldn't help but pick upwards. Wei Shi drank a lot of wine after his whole body relaxed, the maids that were singing and dancing at the banquet attracted his eyes, the wonderful dancing posture mesmerized Wei Shi, his face flushed and his mouth unknowingly opened wide.
Just as the song, dance and wine were in full swing, Zhao's agents based in the capital of Wu delivered the latest news from Wu.
"Zheng Yuming refuses to inherit the throne?" Zhao Xuan was astonished.
"Yes. The ministers of King Wu's court kneeled down to ask Prince Lok Yan to succeed the throne, but they were all rejected by him." The detailer's address to Zheng Yuming followed the custom of the people of Kang City.
"Hehe, it's just a pretense." Zhao Xuan said sarcastically, who doesn't want to climb to the pinnacle of power, pretending to excuse himself is just to sit on the throne. Zheng Yuming's identity as a prince, Zhao Xuan is half believing, but for the sake of the interests of Zhao, he can't admit it.
"Prince Lok Yan said that he fled overseas eleven years ago, and only returned to Wu to visit because he missed his father and elder brother, and was ordered by his elder brother's legacy to lead the army to quell the rebellion, and now that the situation in Wu has been settled, his mission has been accomplished. Not only is the governor of Lok Yan unwilling to succeed to the throne himself, but he has also put forward the Western Marquis and his own concubine uncle as candidates for the throne."
"Push for two candidates? Who has a chance of winning?" Zhao Xuan stroked his chin as he searched for Zheng Yuming's motives. The Western Marquis was also a concubine, he was the uncle of the King of Wu, and Gong Zi Ming's concubine uncle was the King of Wu's only remaining concubine brother, so if Gong Zi Ming did not want to be the King of Wu, these two were the closest in blood and the most qualified.
"It's Marquis Xi, Duke Ming's concubine uncle's character is tainted and was overruled by the ministers of the royal court, and this concubine uncle was an accomplice when the adulterous consort rebelled and harmed the life of another concubine brother." Dafu Jiang, who was still locked up in the royal city's prison, confessed to this throne candidate's private bottom's sordid affairs.
"Then the next King of Wu will be the Western Marquis?"
"That was the opinion of the Minister of the Court of King Wu when my humble servant came out of the royal capital." Because of the snow and difficult traveling, the Zhao country's fine agent rode for five days from Kangcheng before arriving here in Zhao Xuan. The informant's message was from five days ago.
"Why doesn't Duke Falling Goose himself ascend to the throne? Could it be that he's really a fake prince? Afraid that his position on the throne will be unstable?" Zhao Xuan's eyes lit up when he thought of this, "What is the status of the war between Wu and Tang? Is the Wu army in an unfavorable position?"
"The Wu army is not at a disadvantage, the news from the Wu border back to the royal capital is that the Tang army has been surrounded by the Wu army, and with the lack of food and clothing and heating firewood, the Tang army is freezing to death and starving to death countless times a day. The people of Kang City are speculating that the Tang army has surrendered." It also took two days for the news to travel from the border back to Kangcheng, and the people of Kangcheng were convinced that the Tang army would not survive two more days and nights of starvation and cold.
Zhao Xuan was dumbfounded after hearing this and muttered, "Could it be that Duke Flying Goose is indeed Duke Ming? He refused to inherit the throne because of humility?"
The Northern Marquis was destroyed, the Tang army was trapped, Wu is no longer a threat, the army is in the hands of Chu Chao Hui and Wei Ren, Zheng Yuming can sit firmly on the throne even if he is a fake prince, but the steady throne to others, can only say that he is really modest. This Zheng Yuming if not a fool, can only use the true gentleman to describe him.
Zhao Xuan began to get annoyed in his heart when he thought of this. If Zheng Yuming had ascended to the throne, Zhao could still use the Northern Marquis' letter to question Zheng Yuming's status as a prince, and use troops to Wu to occupy Qu City on the grounds of avenging the Northern Marquis. However, now that the throne of Wu is inherited by the Western Marquis, Zhao has no excuse to send troops, the Western Marquis's qualifications as the heir are above the Northern Marquis, and Zhao has no place to question him.
Zhao Xuan rejoined the banquet looking preoccupied, he is really not willing to 20,000 Zhao troops to spend money and effort to work for half a month but to no avail. Zhao Xuan sipped his wine and contemplated, but was interrupted by the singing and dancing maid with a shriek. When he looked up, it turned out to be the drunken Duke of Wei, Zi Shi, who staggered to the table and grabbed the corner of the dancing maid's coat. His behavior caused the generals of Zhao to laugh.
Zhao Xuan watched the scene, the corner of his mouth picked up, and there was a smile in his eyes, there was no excuse to claim land against Wu, but taking advantage of the fact that Wu's vitality had been greatly injured, and taking Wei into his pocket, it was a once-in-a-lifetime good time. As for the reason for annexation, there is no can immediately create one.
While Zhao Xuan was pondering the annexation of Wei, the Western Marquis was dying of an old injury, lying on a large bed in the royal palace in Kang City.
After Chu Chaohui returned to the royal capital and learned of Zheng Yuming's thoughts, he left the palace early the next morning to do an errand, and he took Huang Zhong to the dungeon to interrogate Dr. Jiang. On the third day, Dr. Jiang and the rest of the party's confessions identifying the crimes of King Wu's concubine brothers appeared in front of the ministers of the royal court. The only surviving candidate for succession to the throne from the three concubine brothers of the King of Wu was immediately rejected by the ministers of the royal court. The Hussar General and many nobles once again requested Jung Yoo Min to succeed the throne, but Jung Yoo Min still firmly refused.
The Western Marquis and Wei Shen carried the coffin of Duke Ziguang into the royal capital under the escort of Guo Si. The Yi Ji had been destroyed, the remaining members of the gang, Jiang Dafu and Xi Sima, had been caught, Duke Ziguang's revenge had been avenged, and after his wish had been fulfilled, his coffin would be buried in the royal tomb.
When he arrives at the royal capital, Xihou realizes that he has become a candidate for the throne. When Jung Yuming asks Xihou to succeed the throne, Xihou asks Jung Yuming to succeed the throne in return. The two of them are repeatedly humbled in front of the throne, and in the end, Xihou is physically weaker than Jung Yuming, and is pressed by Jung Yuming on top of the throne to accept the congratulations of the royal court ministers.
After the Western Marquis was pressed to inherit the throne, he had been in a bad mood until Zheng Yuming had a long heart-to-heart discussion with him in the evening, and only then did the Western Marquis's frown slowly ease, and the next day in the royal court, he appointed Zheng Yuming as the prime minister, the prime minister of the royal court of all the administrative affairs, and Chu Chaohui as the military premier, the commander of the Wu army. At the request of Yi Ji, the King of Tang organized his army to gather at the end of July at the border of Wu to hold back and help Yi Ji to seize the throne. Tang, like Wu, was a coastal country, with the eastern part of its territory facing the sea.
Both Tang and Wu had salt farms, and the salt-making process in this time and space was to boil brine with seawater and fry it into salt. This kind of primitive salt boiling is time-consuming, fuel-consuming, and the production is small. Because there is a big river running through the middle of the Qin Dynasty into the sea (the big river is similar to the Yellow River, and the long river in the territory of Wu is similar to the Yangtze River), the salt content of the seawater near the salt farms of the Tang Dynasty is lowered, and it costs more fuel and labor to burn the sea salt. On the other hand, Wu's salt farm in the East China Sea had good water quality and high salt concentration, so it was easier to burn sea salt than Tang, and the sea salt was of higher quality than Tang.
Salt is indispensable to everyone's life, and at that time boiling was not easy, resulting in a high price of salt in the market, the two suitable places for boiling salt in Tang and Wu were the main source of economic resources for the inner coffers of the rulers of these two countries.
The people of this time and space will not drill wells to mine salt, and do not realize that there are natural brine and rock salt deposits under the ground, the source of salt in addition to sea salt is lake salt. In addition to half of the salt boiled by Tang was consumed at home, half was sold at high price to the inland countries that did not have lake salt. Many inland vassal states such as Zhao, Qi, Chen and Chu needed to import salt. The salt that Tang sold to the outside world was the biggest economic source for the King of Tang.
South port and the valley production of exquisite brocade, porcelain, glass products appeared, living a luxurious life of course, the king of the Tang Dynasty to spend a huge amount of money to buy to enjoy, flowing money into the merchants and manufacturing place to go, the king of the Tang Dynasty feel the beginning of economic constraints.
Over the past twenty years, because of climate change, there were frequent disasters in the Tang Dynasty, and the taxes on farmland became less and less. The King of Tang repeatedly levied more taxes, but because of the people's food shortfalls in the years of disasters, the grain officials and nobles who collected the taxes could not meet the King's requirements even if they raided the people's homes. The King of Tang's exorbitant levies, on the other hand, led to the abandonment of the land by many people who fled to the mountains or to the neighboring countries, and a large portion of the fleeing people fled to the Ulsan Mountain.
King Tang could not increase his income from the land, so he wanted to increase the tribute from the nobles, which was unanimously rejected by the nobles. King Tang's second idea to increase his income was aborted.
All the places that could increase income, King Tang went to increase, the number of increased income makes King Tang very dissatisfied. At the end of the day, the King of Tang could only toss more at his salt farms, with the idea of letting the salt workers at the salt farms boil more salt to increase production.
Because salt production adopts boiling method, which requires a large amount of fuel, the trees near the salt farms of the Tang Dynasty were cut down and dried for boiling salt, resulting in the lack of firewood available around the salt farms, and the dry firewood for boiling salt at the salt farms had to be transported by mule carts from dozens of miles away. The transportation of fuel wood alone was a waste of countless manpower and animal resources. When the fuel for boiling salt could not be guaranteed, of course the production could not be increased, and King Tang's hope of increasing the production of the salt farm was dashed.
When the King of Tang was unable to increase his income by all means he could think of for his country, he turned his attention to the surrounding countries. The countries bordering Tang, except Wei, were all stronger and bigger than Tang, and Wei, which was weaker than Tang, was in turn safe after becoming a place for the two countries to play games because most of its land area was a buffer for the borders of Zhao and Wu, and Tang, facing the two strong countries of Zhao and Wu, of course did not dare to seize Wei. The way for the King of Tang to get rich by waging war against the weaker countries was simply impossible.
Just when the Tang King was at a loss, Yi Ji contacted the Tang King through Dr. Jiang, hoping to get the Tang King to send troops to help her in her plan to get rid of the tiger. The King of Tang was overjoyed when he realized the intention of Ripple Ji, and asked Ripple Ji to use the east coast of Wu as a reward, and finally reached an agreement after several rounds of negotiation with Dr. Jiang.
The king of Tang was full of confidence to get the East China Sea, he promised generous benefits to the Tang nobles who sent troops, quickly gathered more than 10,000 Huben, and more than 20,000 auxiliary soldiers, led the army camped on the border, just waiting for Ri Ji's success in seizing the throne, he can get Ri Ji rewarded by the East China Sea.
In the view of the Tang King, this operation of the Tang army was a tour of the mountains and a visit to the border of Wu. What the King of Tang did not anticipate was the sudden rise of the army of Duke Ming's crusade in Ulsan, which prevented him from realizing his wish quickly.
When the Ulsan army destroyed Ri Ji's 20,000 Huben and 30,000 army at the mouth of Ulsan Road and swung north to conquer, the Tang King was not calm in his heart, he was afraid that Ri Ji would fail, in that case, not only would he not get paid, but there would be no one to compensate for the wasted financial and material resources.
After pondering for a long time, King Tang felt that he should take advantage of the civil war in Wu to seize the East Coast of the Sea first. King Tang did not take the Wu army at the border of Wu in his eyes, because he knew that the army's food and supplies were controlled by Ripple.
For the sake of the safety of the royal capital, Ri Ji has requested the Tang army to retreat twice, so that the Wu army at the border of Wu will be able to save the army. Paper tiger's army is unbearable, the Tang army and such no fighting force army engagement, can easily break the Wu army defense line to take down the East China Sea coast, to achieve the fact that occupy the East China Sea coast.
If Ri Ji wins, the East China Sea was originally her promised reward, and Wu will naturally not send troops to take it back. God did not give the King of Tang a good chance, not only did he not give him the possibility to leave safely, but instead, there was a massive cooling down and heavy snowfall. The second course was to abolish the private soldiers on the fiefs of the feudal lords, whose security would not have to be guaranteed by themselves, but would henceforth be taken care of by the royal court for law and order and security.
The Western Marquis believed that the source of the great turmoil in Wu was the fact that Jiang Dafu had raised 8,000 private soldiers and had the backing to help Ri Ji succeed in usurping the throne. Since the Xia Dynasty, there have been five levels of titles: Duke, Husband, Uncle, Son and Man. After the founding of Great Qin, the same system of titles was adopted. The titles were hereditary, and the fiefdoms were all called states, thus forming various kinds of large and small vassal states, and within the vassal states, there were titles such as marquis, uncle, grandmaster, scholar, and so on, and the marquis, uncle, grandmaster had fiefdoms, and they could exercise the right of rule over the fiefdoms, and were only subject to the orders of the vassals. This kind of feudal system, over time, had the consequence of being too big to fail. The wise vassal rulers realized that this system would cause them to lose control of their localities, just as the Qin Emperor lost control of his vassal states.
Not wanting to end up in the same situation as the Qin Emperor, eight years earlier, the king of Zhao had taken the lead in reforming the system in his country by converting the fiefs of the feudal lords into cognacs, where the peasants on the fiefs of the feudal lords labored and paid rents for them, but could not exercise administrative power there, which the king of Zhao had brought back to the central government.
As the state of Wu was close to the state of Zhao, the king of Wu also wanted to reform the system as Zhao did, but she was persuaded by Yi Ji, who was about to develop her own power through the fiefs of Jiang Dafu, and she did not want the king of Wu to make drastic reforms to the fiefs. Yi Ji's reasoning was that since Zhao had tried the reforms first and did not know the consequences yet, Wu could have waited to see the changes in Zhao before making a decision.
After being persuaded by Yi Ji, the King of Wu's reform plan was delayed. After Zhao reformed the title system, the state became stronger and stronger day by day, but the King of Wu no longer had the energy to make drastic changes to the status quo of Wu because of his health.
With Zhao's successful reform column in front of them, the rulers of Yan, Chu, Qi, and Lu had already carried out or were preparing to carry out title reforms one after another.

In the ancient times, the filial son treated the deceased as if he were alive. The offerings made on the 100th day clearly indicated that after the 100th day, the family would no longer send food to the deceased every day, but the deceased would make his own "food". This is because they believe that even though a person leaves the earth and goes to another world (the netherworld), he still needs to eat in the netherworld, just like on earth, and after the 100th day, the deceased should be able to get used to the netherworld without having to have his family bring him food anymore. Many of these nobles were the regular customers of the wine shop, and with the loss of customers, the business of the wine shop would of course be poor.
However, at the end of the year, the business of the brewery was the opposite of what the owner had predicted. Not only did the business of the brewery not deteriorate, but it also became prosperous. There were fewer old customers, but more new ones. For example, the merchants who flocked to the brewery were the most generous in their consumption of wine. There were also the Huben who received generous retirement allowances, and if they were originally good at wine, they would often patronize it when they had a large amount of coins in their hands. However, when he saw a farmer dressed in rags with a bag of goods on his shoulder passing by the entrance, he felt that he had figured out the reason for the crowded and lively King's City.

A noon in the middle of March, the northern part of Wu Qi Men Mountain, the trees have just put on a new green dress, gully side of the wildflowers swaying, a gust of breeze will be the fragrance of flowers and grasses into the people's noses.
A rabbit squatting in the grass on the side of the road gnawing on young grass, suddenly, the rabbit stopped moving, 'suddenly' a leap into the bushes, a moment will be gone, and the rabbit was gnawing on the grass, ran a back dark brown, neck black, limbs fur gray and white big wolf dog.
The big wolf dog sniffed at the grass, lifted its legs and peed, leaving its own scent behind, and then happily ran back to the trail on the side of the grass to wait for its master.
On the trail there is a team of pedestrians on horseback, the number of twelve, three people, all young and strong men, dressed smart, crotch horses look quite good, the end of the team there are three mule carts loaded with goods. The trail at the foot of the mountain is the natural path that the mountain people walk out, not wide, barely able to accommodate two horses walking side by side, but also barely able to pass the mule cart.
"Da Niu, how far is this place from Da Xian's residence?" The young man in the foremost position of the horse team was very handsome, a green shirt set off his skin like jade and porcelain, riding a very athletic white steed, this person was Zheng Yuming who should be staying in the capital city of Wu.
The appearance of their team was dressed up as traders acquiring herbs, Zheng Yuming was the proprietor, Huang Zhong was dressed up as a housekeeper, Da Niu and Ma Ren, the guards were made up as footmen and fellows. "It takes about a day to walk, and three or four hours to ride a horse." Da Niu heard Zheng Yuming ask, and hastened to answer on his horse, Da Niu is a resident at the foot of Qimen Mountain, growing up to the age of ten often into the mountains, he is too familiar with this area. Da Niu mouth of an hour refers to two hours.
"In that case, we won't necessarily be able to make it before nightfall?" Zheng Yuming looked up at the sky and his eyebrows couldn't help but furrow.
When we hit the road in the morning, the sky was still cloudless, but by midday the clouds were so thick that they blocked out the sun as well, and the south-easterly winds increased in strength, so that the temperature at midday seemed colder than in the morning.
"The earliest we can get to the Daxian residence is after the eleventh hour." Riding a horse on a mountain trail wasn't much faster than walking on two legs, except that it was much less laborious for a person to walk on a horse.

The eleventh hour was seven o'clock in the evening, and he was afraid that before he arrived at Daxian's residence, the people in the horse team would have to be drenched in the rain. Now that the temperature was not high, people and livestock could easily get sick after getting wet, and if a cold turned into pneumonia it could be fatal.

"Your Excellency! One hour further on, there is an abandoned logging place with a few dilapidated houses, we can go there and set up camp for the night." Da Niu originally logged in Qimen Mountain and knew the surrounding terrain like the back of his hand.
"That's just right, I guess by the time we settle down, this rain is going to fall." Zheng Yuming looked up at the sky, which was already cloudy.
After making the decision to set up camp for the night, the carriage team stepped up their speed to move forward, hoping to arrive at the camping ground earlier to set up their tents and rest. They had been on the road for three days coming from the royal capital to Qimen Mountain, the first night there was a post station to rest, the second night was a night stay in a small village, and today was the third day, so they could only camp for the night in the wilderness.
Zheng Yuming's concern about the weather was right, in the evening, the sky was drizzling, at first it was still fluttering, gradually it began to intensify. Because the horse team found a campsite in advance, both people and horses avoided the rain.

Nearly a year after the death of Marquis Xihou, the imperial decree of the Emperor of Qin came to confer a posthumous title on him. The short-lived king of Wu received the posthumous title of Rui, and Marquis Xihou was known as King Rui of Wu. With the granting of the posthumous title by the Emperor of Qin, the succession of King Sheng of Wu to the throne was justified and no one could question it any more. The second year of King Sheng of Wu was a year of disaster.
In this year, most places in the north-central part of the Great Qin continent were in drought, and many farmers in the countries of Qi, Lu, and Yan did not have any harvests, while in the countries of Zhao, Chen, and Chu in the central and southern parts of the continent, the harvests of their fields were also reduced quite a lot. Only Wu, the whole country to improve water conservancy, to fertilize the fields, the use of advanced and convenient farming equipment farming, the country planted a large area of high-yield drought-resistant crops, coupled with the Wu is located in the south, the many rivers, by the arid climate less affected, the Wu Autumn Harvest this year to obtain a bumper harvest.
Although the autumn harvest of Wu was a great harvest, the winter wheat planting in the coming year must be reduced, because the winter of this year came too early and too cold. Wheat seeds sown in early October, because of the snowfall, the temperature is too cold, the wheat seeds were frozen, sown wheat did not emerge, wait until the temperature warmed up, the officials around the country hastily organized farmers to replenish the seeds, no more wheat seeds farmers, you can go to the official government on credit, to minimize the sudden cold weather on the crops brought about by the disaster.
At the end of October, the weather in Wu was still cold, except that the snow had melted in the fields, and the fields were full of farmers busy replanting winter wheat. On the avenue not far away came a group of horse riders and a dog.
"This winter will be cold and long, the local officials must make sure that the people prepare sufficient firewood for the winter." When the first person wearing a white fox fur trimmed black brocade robe, riding a snow white steed, this person's face is handsome, slender, it is the Premier of Wu Zheng Yuming, followed by the officials who manage the civil affairs of Kangcheng, of course, the big bull and guards do not leave the left and right, wood is now as long as the master goes out, it will certainly follow.
"Your Excellency, after Mr. Gongsun's prediction of the weather came out, my humble servant had the Yamen go to villages all over the place to look after the people to pick up more firewood to prepare for winter, and the feudal lords of the surrounding mountains that have big mountains have all sent out circulars not allowing them to close the mountains privately." The one who answered Zheng Yuming was the Secretary Farmer official in charge of agricultural affairs around Kangcheng.
"The feudal lords with mountains should still be given some financial assistance." The answer of the Si-nong officer pleased Zheng Yuming, but for those feudal lords who owned mountains, Zheng Yuming did not want to suppress them too hard.
The nobles who still have fiefdoms in Wu are the original supporters of Ulsan's crusade against Yi Ji. Now that Ulsan's forces are in control, Zheng Yuming has taken their interests into consideration when reforming the nation's land, and for the former supporters, Zheng Yuming has taken the initiative of surveying the arable land in their fiefdoms, and charging them a tax of five percent of the acres of arable land surveyed, which is half the amount compared to the rest of the nation. And the mountains and forests on the fiefdom, according to the area to collect not much mountain forest tax. In this way, compared to the original tribute, the taxes borne by the nobles did not increase.
These policies were only enjoyed by the nobles who embraced the Ulsan regime, those Tang nobles who had just annexed into Wu's land, and the Wei nobles who had already been extinguished did not have such luck; the Wei nobles were still able to enjoy Wu's national treatment, and the fief nobles of the Tang who had ceded to Wu's land were directly given to Zhou Cheng's army to be driven back to the Northern Tang, with their estates and properties being confiscated.
"As you wish, I will send someone to understand the actual situation and compensate them according to the damage they suffered." This Si Nong official was very competent.
Zheng Yuming nodded, fortunately there are not many nobles with fiefdoms now, and these fiefdoms will not be hereditary, after twenty to thirty years, the fiefdom nobles will disappear within the country of Wu. There are even fewer fiefdom nobles with mountains and forests, and the funds to compensate these nobles for the loss of mountains and forests being cut down by commoners is not too much, and the compensation measures are just to appease these nobles.
Zheng Yuming took his men on a morning patrol around Kangcheng, casually visited a few villages, and found that the villagers were actively replanting winter wheat, and that the villagers had enough leftover food at home, and picked up quite a lot of dry firewood, and after praising the seriousness of the Sifu Nonggong officials, Zheng Yuming ended the patrol and returned to the Prime Minister's Office.

The performance process is also different from the past as only a simple accompaniment of gongs and drums, the whole process of mixing a variety of music, rare is that the role in the performance process also said lines, so that the viewer understands what is happening in the theater.

Bur Yao cautiously observed the movements of the defending soldiers on the city wall and found that those soldiers were not panicking in the face of the enemy army's pressure and were doing their defense work methodically. Wei Qing has not yet received news of the progress of Ma Ren's waterway attack, and what the specifics of Ma Ren's attack on the king's capital are, Wei Qing is not clear, but this does not prevent Wei Qing from snubbing Bo Yao.
"What? You have captured the Tang King's capital?" "General Wei, I think at the beginning my Crown Prince and your country's great general have an agreement that the two countries will send troops together to conquer Tang, now that our army has arrived at this place, the general should open the gates of the city, so that our army can pass through and swing north to annihilate the remnants of the King of Tang." "Wu Zai this is greatly incorrect, it was agreed that whichever side's army had laid down the ground would be owned by that side's country, and the other side that arrived late would have to make a detour, now that this city is already a Wu land, if your country wants to wield its army northward, please enter from the northern mountain range." Bo Yao used his strong will to force himself to swallow the angry curses that had already reached his mouth, and he squeezed the threat out of his teeth word by word: "General Wei, our country's 50,000 soldiers and horses can't make a trip for nothing, if General Wei refuses to let our country's army pass through the city, Bo Yao will have to lead these 50,000 strong soldiers to break through!"

While Wei Qing was fooling Bo Yao, Ma Ren was leading his army to attack the capital of Tang, and Chu Chao Hui, who was sitting in the northwest county, had already arrived at the river crossing near the capital of Tang by boat.

"Noe! Please don't worry General, my humble servant will definitely take the Royal Palace as soon as possible!" The officer looked aghast and led the way.
The Wu army stepped up their attack, using two feints to attract most of the palace guards, and concentrating most of their own forces on attacking the open areas of the Tang army's defenses. Wu soldiers clad in armor and holding big shields climbed up the wall of the royal palace against the enemy arrows and engaged in a fierce physical battle with the Tang palace guards.

As the Wu soldiers stood firm on the palace wall, the Wu soldiers had a foothold, and more and more of them climbed up from the ladder. The Tang soldiers saw that the situation was not good. "Capture the Younger King alive!"
"Don't let the Faint King escape, capture him alive and cut him into a thousand pieces!"
The Wu soldiers rushed towards the inner palace with high shouts, the palace where King Tang lived was in the inner palace, the wall of the inner palace was not high, and there was no garrison to defend it, there were only more than a hundred attendants guarding the inner palace gate. King Tang's tyrannical temper, the attendant service is slightly less than satisfactory, will make the palace guards flogging, in recent times, the King of Tang because of Wu's army pressure, more temperamental, serving his attendants waitresses have had bad luck, flogging and maiming is commonplace, was executed every day, the King's Palace of Tang every day to drag out a few bloody corpses, attendants waitresses trembled and dared not speak out of anger.
Before the Wu army did not attack the palace, there were palace guards who were loyal to the Tang King to suppress them, or they were afraid of the Tang King's counter-attack and liquidation, and the Tang King's palace attendants did not dare to rebel and defect, and after the Wu army captured the palace, the attendants no longer had any fear, and the Tang King would no longer be the master of their lives and deaths.
When Ma Ren led his troops to attack the Tang Wangdu, Chu Chao Hui took his personal guards ashore from the ship to supervise the battle near the Tang Wangdu city. When the gates of the Tang King's capital were blown open, Chu Chao Hui happened to receive a short report sent by Wei Qing and Zhou Cheng. After Chu Chao Hui read the report, he gave instructions to Wei Qing and Zhou Cheng respectively, Wei Qing continued to guard the border passes, Zhou Cheng's troops left 5,000 to guard the salt farms, and the rest went north to capture the northern cities of the Tang Dynasty, striving to capture the entire Tang Dynasty within half a month.
Chu Chao Hui here had only finished giving his instructions when Wei Ren sent someone to deliver the good news that the Tang King's Palace had been captured by the Wu soldiers.
"Go! Let's go meet that King of Tang!" Chu Chao Hui waved his hand and led his personal guards straight to the Tang King's Palace.
Wu soldiers have taken control of the main roads in the city of the Tang king's capital, and the resisting forces in the Tang king's palace have been cleaned up, the surrendered Tang soldiers cleaned up the battlefield under the surveillance of the Wu soldiers, and the blood on the ground had not yet coagulated when Chu Chaohui rode into the king's palace, but the corpses of the soldiers who died in the battle near the high wall of the king's palace had already been carried away and put in peace separately, the remains of the Wu soldiers were cremated and brought back to the Wu country for burial, and the corpses of Tang soldiers were identified and claimed away by their relatives. "Ma Ren, where is King Tang?" Chu Chao Hui rode to the Harem, and Ma Ren was frowning at a three-story attic, which was surrounded by a regiment of Wu Bing.
"Report to the Great General! That dimwitted ruler wants to set himself on fire!" Ma Ren saw Chu Chao Hui coming and hurriedly dismounted to report.
"King Tang is going to set himself on fire?" Chu Chao Hui then realized that the attic was surrounded by piles of dry wood.
"When the dim king saw that the palace walls were broken down, he forced his personal attendants' maids and favored concubines with their sons and daughters to go up to this attic with him."
"Then why didn't King Tang light the fire?" It had been at least an hour since the palace wall was broken.
Ma Ren smiled bitterly, "Reporting to the Great General, that dusky king couldn't lay his hands on himself."
Chu Chao Hui raised an eyebrow, "Since King Tang can't get down on his own, why don't you help him out a bit?" What Chu Chao Hui meant was that King Tang was afraid of death and didn't have the courage to light the dry wood, Ma Ren was perfectly capable of helping him light it.
Ma Ren shook his head and sighed: "Reporting to the Great General, this attic is the Tang King's Treasure House where he stores his gold, silver and jewels, and the Duke has the care that the Tang King's Palace's belongings shall not be lost."
Ma Ren is concerned about these treasures, even if the attic has been surrounded by the Wu soldiers, Ma Ren does not dare to let the soldiers force the attic to board the attic to capture the King of Tang alive, for fear of stimulating the King of Tang to have the courage to ignite the dry wood, so that the attic treasures are damaged.
Chu Chao Hui stroked his chin, rode his horse around the attic, and had a countermeasure afterward.

King Tang is carrying a sword on the roof of the attic rooftop circles, attic rooftop center has a burning fire tripod, rooftop of the surrounding kneeling full of King Tang's children, concubines and servants served his servants. "King Tang, you have committed so many sins that your death will not be enough to cover your crimes! Chu Chao Hui loudly condemned the King of Tang.
King Tang thought that Chu Chaohui was negotiating with him when he saw him, he thought that he still had a chance of survival, but he didn't want Chu Chaohui to ask him to die quickly and not to drag others into it, he looked around and found that his attendants and maids all showed hope in their eyes, and his two young concubine consorts also stopped crying and looked at him with anticipation. The Tang King's face muscles twisted, in his conception, all people should be like Fu Chou's mentor Jitu, who went to death for him without complaint, even if it was his own flesh and blood.
"Thou art a man of lethargy and cruelty! Thou art a follower of the people, and hast refused to spare the faithful to the end of their lives! Thou shalt die ten thousand times to thank heaven and earth! Thou shalt not be so obstinate as to martyr thyself with innocent lives." "Haha! I'd like to see who can live and die!" King Tang's eyes glowed red, and his entire person was a little crazy.
"Your Majesty! Sixth son is still young, I hope your majesty will have mercy," a concubine hugged her three year old son tightly, sobbing and pleading with King Tang.
King Tang stared viciously at his Ji Concubine, "Bitch! In vain of Lone's previous favor, on the occasion of breaking the country, you are so afraid of death!"
Concubine Ji knelt on the ground and kowtowed desperately, "I am not doing this for myself, it is because my son is too young, so I hope that Your Majesty will have mercy on him and give him a way out!"
King Tang looked up to the sky and laughed maniacally, "Since I was born in the King's family, I have to die for the King's family!"
The king of Tang finished straight cut to their own young children, ready to young children Ji Fei all cut to death and then self-immolation. Weeping Ji Fei saw the sword stabbed at the wailing son, swooped down on his son to protect, only to hear a scream, the King of Tang's sword penetrated the back of the Ji Fei.
King Tang's concubines and waiters and waitresses were habitually afraid of King Tang's lustful authority, and because the defeated monarchs and clansmen would be killed by the victors, and those who served the monarchs could not be spared, and they felt that it was all a matter of death, so no one was born to resist when King Tang forced them to be martyred in the Jumbo Pavilion.
Chu Chao Hui's words gave the martyrs on the rooftop a way out, and the hope of life was right in front of them, giving them the courage to fight back, while the King of Tang's persistent and unrepentant brutality stirred up the people's anger, and one of the attendants roared out, and violently pounced on the King of Tang, and pounced the King of Tang to the ground.
King Tang's sword hadn't been pulled out of Concubine Ji, and without a weapon, he could only physically fight with the attendant, and the two of them rolled on the rooftop to fight.
"Those who capture the Faint King alive will be rewarded generously!" Seeing the chaos on the rooftop, Chu Chao Hui hurriedly inspired more people to rise up in resistance.
As soon as Chu Chao Hui's words fell, a few more attendants stood up and pounced on King Tang. The Wu soldiers surrounding under the attic hurriedly moved the firewood in front of the attic door and hit the attic door with the battering ram, and after opening the door, the Wu soldiers swarmed up.
When King Tang was brought to Chu Chao Hui by his attendants bound, he was already in quite a sorry state, the crown on his head had fallen off, his hair was spread out, the king's clothes on his body were torn, his shoes were lost in the fight, and he was bare with two big feet.
Chu Chao Hui looked at the Tang King who was paralyzed in front of him with a smile and instructed Ma Ren, "Empty the treasures in the Treasure Pavilion and seal them together with those in the other palaces to send them to the Premier Minister."
Chu Chao Hui imagined Zheng Yuming's expression when he saw the gold, silver, and jewelry belongings, and he must have smiled with a wide-eyed smile.
"Yes, sir!" Ma Ren cupped his fists and led the order, he looked at the paralyzed Tang King and asked Chu Chaohui for instructions, "Is this dusky king also sent to the Premier Minister?"
"No, it's better to return King Tang to the attic rooftop, let's do something good and let him have his wish!" Chu Chao Hui wouldn't let Zheng Yuming get blood on his hands.
Paralyzed on the ground, the Tang King was horrified to hear that Chu Chao Hui was still going to burn himself to death with fire, and just as he opened his mouth to make a sound, a piece of rag was stuffed into his mouth, and he was re-dragged by the Wu soldiers to the rooftop of the attic like a dead pig.
History records that in the third year of King Sheng of Wu, the capital of Tang was captured by the army of Wu, and the King of Tang rebelled against his own family and set himself on fire alone in the Treasure Pavilion of the inner palace, and countless treasures disappeared into the fire along with the King of Tang.

Zhao Xuan took 10,000 elite soldiers and drove furiously all the way back to the king's capital in only three days. After Zhao Xuan's return, the Chu army, which had already set up camp outside the king's capital, had already retreated on their own one day ahead of schedule.
The soldiers and horses brought back by Zhao Xuan were too tired to run back and forth, and it was not suitable to go after Gongzi Xie immediately when they were tired and the horses were sleepy. By the time more than 10,000 soldiers and horses recuperated and recovered their spirit, it was already the third day after Gongzi Xie retreated.
Zhao Xuan wanted to catch up with the king's son and wipe him out in one fell swoop, exterminating the last bloodline of the royal family of Wei and completely extinguishing the hope of restoration of the occupied territories. What Zhao Xuan didn't expect was that the king's son, who was originally an idiot, became enlightened after four years of exile in Chu, his IQ became higher, he became cunning, and he also became a scoundrel.
Although Gongzi Xie led the Chu soldiers only to loiter around Zhao Wangdu and did not bring any damage to Zhao Wangdu, Gongzi Xie created very much trouble for Zhao Xuan on his way to retreat.
Duke Yi rode a jujube-red horse in high spirits, with an excited face: "General Zuo's strategizing and decision-making are better than Jiang Xiang's, and the general is a martial minister given to Wei by the gods!"
Gongzi Xie was more and more satisfied with Zuo Yi.
Zuo Yi smiled slightly, after being praised by Gongzi Shi, there was not a trace of pride on his face, on the contrary, he appeared to be very modest: "Yi is fortunate to be appreciated by Gongzi, so that he can show his life's ambition, Gongzi's kindness to Yi's acquaintance, Yi is grateful."
Gongzi Xie shook his head and looked very proud, thinking that he had much more discerning eyes than the Ming Duke and the Great General of Wu, and was able to find such a handsome person with outstanding military talent like Zuo Yi.
"Are we just going to rob all the way there?" Gongzi Xie looked back at the possessions loaded on the Chu army's horses, which were the fruits of their looting along the way.
In Gongzi Xie's eyes, Zuo Yi's judgment was very strong, as if he could always guess Zhao Xuan's actions correctly. The day after Zhao Xuan returned with his troops, Zuo Yi analyzed the news brought back by his spies that Zhao Xuan was going to come back from the border of Tang and Zhao to rescue him. Based on Zuo Yi's accurate judgment, Gongzi was able to lead the Chu army to retreat gracefully.
Gongzi Xie knew that the 6,000 troops he had rented were too few, and it was impossible to defeat Zhao with this force. The reason why he sent troops against Zhao this time was that he wanted to take advantage of the emptiness of Zhao's royal capital to steal a handful of opportunities, and now that Zhao Xuan returned with a large army, Gongzi Xie's speculative action failed, and he could only go back to his home.
He went back empty-handed, Gongzi Xie was very reluctant, Zuo Yi seemed to know what Gongzi Xie thought, and immediately came up with a good idea for Gongzi Xie, which was to rob the nobles of Zhao on the way back.
As long as it is not a fortified city, villages, manor houses and these easy to attack places are places of interest to Zuo Yi, every time a place is captured, the noble families in this place will be looted by the Chu army, and every time they loot something, Zuo Yi will come to play the tycoon and divide the items into actions. A lot of grain and livestock were distributed to the local people. Zuo Yi paid attention to one point, that is, he did not let the nobles and the servants of the nobles to see the people to collect the things, so as to prevent the nobles from retaliating against the people in the future.
Gong Zi Xi led the Chu army all the way to do the robbery after the hook, but also in the local people left a good reputation, these poor people privately and vocally praised Gong Zi Xi as a great benevolence and righteousness of the warrior.
In fact, Zuo Yi was not a chivalrous man. Among the looted things, the most valuable gold, silver and soft goods were all rolled away by Zuo Yi, who needed these belongings to feed his rented soldiers and horses, and waited until he had the chance to launch an attack on Zhao later. Those bulky and heavy things that would affect the retreat of the Chu army were then divided up by Zuo Yi on the spot.
Zhao Xuan followed the trail of Gongzi Xie's retreat, and along the way, there were always nobles who stopped Zhao Xuan's horse and cried. If Zhao Xuan had chased after them, he might have been able to stop them before the Chu army returned to the border of Chu by boat. But faced with the desolation of the looted nobles, Zhao Xuan had to stop to comfort them and send troops to help the nobles recover their divided belongings. Those livestock and furniture and other things that are easy to recognize, the common people heard the news and secretly threw them outside their homes, and Zhao Xuan sent his soldiers to take them away and return them to their rightful owners, but as for the unmarked grain and grass, they couldn't collect all of them.
Zhao Xuan has always prided himself on his love for the people, and for the people who don't want to return the grain, Zhao Xuan can't let the soldiers forcefully confiscate it; after all, Zuo Yi didn't let the nobles see it when he divided the accounts, and the nobles simply don't know which people participated in the division of the accounts. The nobles are resentful that they can't get all of their belongings back, and the people are forced to spit out their livestock and artifacts, so they have a lot of grievances in the back of their minds. Zhao Xuan's handling of this matter along the way can be said to be anxious and annoying.
Zhao Xuan managed to pacify the nobles who suffered losses and led his elite troops to the river mouth at the Zhao-Chu border, only to see the garbage dropped by the Chu army on the beach at the mouth of the river. This hand of 'hitting the landlord and dividing things' played by Gongzi Xie made Zhao Xuan hate him to the core.
Zhao Xuan decides to gather ships to cross the river and chase into the Chu territory, he does not want to lightly spare Gongzi Xie who has made a mess of his kingdom. But just when the boats were almost ready, an urgent message from Bo Yao arrived. After Zhao Xuan read the contents of the urgent letter, he only felt his eyes darken and 'bam' he fell under his horse. When Zhao Xuan woke up, the news of Wu's capture of Tang Wangdu was sent again, Zhao Xuan looked at it silently for a long time and sighed longingly to the sky, only feeling that it was a bad year.
Since there was no more hope of dividing the Tang Empire, Zhao Xuan focused on preparing for the annihilation of Gongzi Xie. However, although the boats for crossing the river were ready, Zhao Xuan brought Zhao troops who were not familiar with water warfare, Zhao Xuan still had to train his troops on the spot to familiarize the soldiers with how to fight on the boats. Only after Zhao Xuan had trained his soldiers not to get seasick, an alert came from the northwest border of Zhao. This time, the alarm has nothing to do with Chu Chao Hui's plotting and scheming, it is the nomadic Rongmen from the north who came south to loot and rob the northwestern border of Zhao, and the northwestern counties of Zhao have been in a state of emergency.
Zhao Xuan was unable to do so and had to press on with his plan to settle the score with Gongzi Xie, leaving 6,000 men stationed at the river bank to prevent Gongzi Xie from crossing the border again, and leading the rest of his troops back to the royal capital, recalling Bo Yao and departing for the north-west to fight against the Rong people.
